33261.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes ikki qismdan iborat: **control plane** (qaror qabul qiladigan "miya": kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, ixtiyoriy cloud-controller-manager) va **worker node**'lar (ish bajaradigan "qo'l": kubelet, container runtime, kube-proxy yoki uning eBPF o'rnini bosuvchisi).

**Nega shunday bo'lingan:** siz "3 ta nginx ishlasin" deb **desired state** yozasiz. Kimdir buni saqlashi (etcd), kimdir qaysi node'ga qo'yishni hal qilishi (scheduler), kimdir doim tekshirib turib farqni tuzatishi (controller) va kimdir node'da haqiqatan container'ni ishga tushirishi (kubelet) kerak. Har vazifa alohida komponent — biri yiqilsa, qolganlari ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl apply
     |
     v
+------------------- control plane -------------------+
|  kube-apiserver  <---->  etcd (yagona holat bazasi) |
|     ^       ^                                       |
|     |       +---- kube-scheduler (pod -> node)      |
|     +------------ controller-manager (reconcile)    |
+-----|-----------------------------------------------+
      | watch / status
      v
+---- worker node (x N) ------------------------------+
| kubelet -> containerd (CRI) -> container'lar         |
| kube-proxy / Cilium -> Service trafigi              |
+-----------------------------------------------------+
```
Muhim qoida: **hamma faqat apiserver bilan gaplashadi**. etcd'ga to'g'ridan faqat apiserver yozadi. Scheduler va controller'lar apiserver'ni *watch* qilib, o'zgarishga reaksiya qiladi (reconcile loop).

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide                 # node'lar, runtime versiyasi
kubectl get pods -n kube-system           # control plane pod'lari (kubeadm'da)
kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'       # apiserver ichki tekshiruvlari
kubectl describe node worker-1 | grep -A5 Conditions
```
`/readyz` chiqishida har bir check `[+]ok` bo'lishi kerak; `[-]etcd failed` — apiserver etcd'ga ulana olmayapti.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- etcd'ni "oddiy DB" deb o'ylab zaxiralamaslik — u yo'qolsa cluster holati yo'qoladi.
- Control plane'da workload ishlatish (taint olib tashlash) — resurs talashi apiserver'ni sekinlashtiradi.
- Managed cluster (EKS/GKE/AKS)'da control plane ko'rinmaydi — bu "yo'q" degani emas, provider boshqaradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Arxitekturaning asosiy g'oyasi — level-triggered reconcile: controller "nima o'zgardi" emas, "hozir qanday va qanday bo'lishi kerak" deb qaraydi. Shu sabab tizim o'zini tiklaydi, lekin apiserver/etcd yagona tor joy — ularning sog'lig'i va latency'si (etcd fsync) butun cluster sog'lig'i.

33262.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Deployment manifestida asosiylari: `apiVersion: apps/v1`, `kind`, `metadata`, `spec.replicas`, `spec.selector`, `spec.template` (pod shabloni: label'lar, container'lar, image, port, resurs, probe). `selector` bilan `template.metadata.labels` mos bo'lishi shart.

**Nega kerak:** pod'ni qo'lda yaratsangiz, u o'lsa hech kim qayta ko'tarmaydi. Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pod zanjiri replika sonini ushlab turadi va versiyalarni rolling update qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Deployment (api)          strategiya, tarix
   |
   v
ReplicaSet (api-7c9f)     aniq pod-template hash
   |
   v
Pod x3                    label app=api
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  labels: { app: api }
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: api }        # qaysi pod'lar "meniki"
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: api }           # selector bilan bir xil!
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0   # aniq tag, latest emas
        ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]
        resources:
          requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
          limits:   { memory: 256Mi }
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
```
```bash
kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f api.yaml   # schema + admission tekshiruvi
kubectl diff -f api.yaml                     # clusterdagidan farqi
kubectl apply -f api.yaml && kubectl rollout status deploy/api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `spec.selector` immutable — keyin o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, Deployment'ni qayta yaratish kerak.
- Selector va template label mos kelmasa — apply xato beradi.
- `resources` yo'q — pod BestEffort bo'ladi, birinchi evict qilinadi.
- `readinessProbe` yo'q — tayyor bo'lmagan pod trafik oladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Manifestni Helm/Kustomize bilan generatsiya qilsangiz ham, CI'da `kubeconform` + `--dry-run=server` bilan tekshiring: xato cluster'ga yetib bormasdan ushlansin.

33263.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Yangi image'ni `kubectl set image` yoki `kubectl apply` bilan berasiz, `kubectl rollout status` bilan kutasiz, muammo bo'lsa `kubectl rollout undo` bilan oldingi ReplicaSet'ga qaytasiz.

**Nega kerak:** deploy — bu bir lahzalik hodisa emas, jarayon: yangi pod'lar ko'tariladi, Ready bo'ladi, eski pod'lar o'chadi. Bu jarayonni kuzatish va yomon chiqsa tez qaytarish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:** har template o'zgarishi yangi ReplicaSet yaratadi; eskilari `replicas: 0` bilan saqlanadi (`revisionHistoryLimit`, default 10). `undo` — oldingi ReplicaSet'ni qayta kattalashtirish.
```
rev1 RS (0)   rev2 RS (0)   rev3 RS (3)  <- hozirgi
                    ^
          rollout undo --to-revision=2
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/api api=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
kubectl annotate deploy/api kubernetes.io/change-cause="v1.5.0 release"
kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=5m   # exit code != 0 bo'lsa CI to'xtaydi
kubectl rollout history deploy/api
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api                  # oldingi revision
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=3
kubectl rollout restart deploy/api               # ConfigMap o'zgargach pod'larni yangilash
kubectl rollout pause deploy/api                 # bir nechta o'zgarishni yig'ish
kubectl rollout resume deploy/api
```
`rollout status` "Waiting for deployment ... 1 of 3 updated replicas are available" deb tursa — yangi pod Ready bo'lmayapti, `kubectl get pods` va `describe` ga qarang.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `progressDeadlineSeconds` (default 600) o'tsa Deployment `ProgressDeadlineExceeded` bo'ladi, lekin **avtomatik rollback qilmaydi**.
- GitOps (Argo CD/Flux) ishlatilsa, `undo` vaqtinchalik — controller Git'dagi holatni qaytarib yozadi. Rollback = `git revert`.
- `--record` flag deprecated; change-cause'ni annotation bilan yozing.

**Senior nuqta:** CI'da `rollout status` timeout'i bilan deploy'ni "tugadi" deb belgilang va xato bo'lsa avtomatik undo qiling; avtomatik metrikaga asoslangan rollback uchun Argo Rollouts/Flagger ishlating.

33264.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Helm — Kubernetes uchun paket menejer. **Chart** — shablonlangan manifestlar paketi, **values** — shablonga beriladigan sozlamalar, **release** — chart'ning cluster'ga o'rnatilgan aniq nusxasi (nomi va revision tarixi bilan).

**Nega kerak:** bitta ilova dev/stage/prod'da 90% bir xil, 10% farqli (replika, domen, resurs). 3 ta nusxa YAML saqlash o'rniga bitta shablon + 3 ta values fayli. Plus — install/upgrade/rollback bitta buyruq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
chart/ (templates + values.yaml)
       +  -f values-prod.yaml  +  --set image.tag=1.5.0
       |
       v
   helm template renderer (Go template)
       |
       v
   tayyor YAML -> apiserver
       |
   release "api" rev N (Secret sifatida namespace'da saqlanadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
helm show values bitnami/redis > redis-values.yaml
helm upgrade --install api ./chart -n prod --create-namespace \
  -f values-prod.yaml --set image.tag=1.5.0 --atomic --timeout 5m
helm list -n prod
helm history api -n prod
helm rollback api 3 -n prod
helm template api ./chart -f values-prod.yaml | less   # nima chiqishini ko'rish
```
`--atomic` — upgrade muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Helm 2 (Tiller) — eskirgan va xavfli edi; bugun faqat Helm 3.
- `--set` bilan ko'p qiymat berish — tarix yo'qoladi; values faylini Git'da saqlang.
- Release holati namespace'dagi Secret'da (`sh.helm.release.v1.*`) — uni o'chirsangiz Helm release'ni "unutadi".
- Kimdir `kubectl edit` qilsa, Helm 3-way merge ba'zan kutilmagan natija beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Chart'larni OCI registry'da versiyalab saqlang (`helm push oci://...`), GitOps bilan birga ishlating: Helm render qiladi, Argo CD/Flux apply va drift'ni boshqaradi.

33265.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kustomize — shablonsiz, **overlay/patch** asosidagi vosita: oddiy YAML base + muhitga xos patch'lar. `kubectl apply -k` ichiga o'rnatilgan. Helm esa shablon (Go template) + paket menejer (versiya, release, rollback, hook).

**Nega ikkalasi bor:** Helm kuchli, lekin shablon ichida `{{ if }}` lar ko'paysa YAML o'qib bo'lmaydigan holga keladi. Kustomize sof YAML'ni saqlaydi — siz faqat "prod'da replika 5, image tag boshqa" deb farqni yozasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
base/                  overlays/prod/
  deployment.yaml        kustomization.yaml
  service.yaml             resources: [../../base]
  kustomization.yaml       patches: replicas=5
                           images: tag=1.5.0
            \             /
             v           v
        kustomize build -> yakuniy YAML
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: prod
resources: [../../base]
images:
- name: ghcr.io/acme/api
  newTag: "1.5.0"
patches:
- target: { kind: Deployment, name: api }
  patch: |-
    - op: replace
      path: /spec/replicas
      value: 5
configMapGenerator:
- name: api-config
  literals: [LOG_LEVEL=info]
```
```bash
kubectl kustomize overlays/prod | less
kubectl apply -k overlays/prod
```
`configMapGenerator` nomga hash qo'shadi -> config o'zgarsa pod'lar avtomatik qayta yaratiladi.

| | Helm | Kustomize |
|---|---|---|
| Model | shablon | patch/overlay |
| Paket/versiya | bor (chart) | yo'q |
| Rollback | `helm rollback` | Git orqali |
| 3rd-party ilova | qulay | noqulay |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kustomize'da shart (if) yo'q — murakkab variantlarga mos emas.
- Ikkalasini aralashtirish mumkin (`helmCharts:` yoki Helm post-renderer), lekin debug qiyinlashadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Amaliy qoida: tashqi ilovalar (ingress-nginx, Prometheus) — Helm; o'z servislaringiz — Kustomize yoki oddiy Helm chart. Muhim — tanlov bitta bo'lsin va CI'da render natijasi tekshirilsin.

33266.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Init container** asosiy container'dan oldin ketma-ket ishlaydi va muvaffaqiyatli tugashi shart (migratsiya, kutish, fayl tayyorlash). **Sidecar** asosiy container bilan parallel butun umr ishlaydi (log shipper, proxy, cert yangilovchi). K8s 1.29+ da native sidecar: `initContainers` ichida `restartPolicy: Always`.

**Muammo:** ilova DB tayyor bo'lmasdan ko'tarilib crash qiladi, yoki har ilovaga log yuborish kodini yozish kerak. Init container tartibni kafolatlaydi, sidecar esa umumiy funksiyani ilovadan ajratadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod start:
 init-1 (tugadi) -> init-2 (tugadi) -> [sidecar (native) start]
                                         |
                                         v
                                   app container start
Pod stop: app to'xtaydi -> keyin sidecar to'xtaydi (native)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: wait-db
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","until nc -z db 5432; do sleep 2; done"]
  - name: log-shipper            # native sidecar (1.29+ beta, default on)
    image: fluent/fluent-bit:3.1
    restartPolicy: Always
    volumeMounts: [{ name: logs, mountPath: /logs }]
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
    volumeMounts: [{ name: logs, mountPath: /logs }]
  volumes:
  - name: logs
    emptyDir: {}
```
```bash
kubectl get pod api-x   # STATUS: Init:0/2 -> init kutilyapti
kubectl logs api-x -c wait-db
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski usuldagi sidecar (oddiy `containers` ichida) Job'ni tugatmaydi — Job pod'i abadiy Running qoladi. Native sidecar buni hal qiladi.
- Init container crash'da butun pod qayta boshlanadi; idempotent yozing.
- Init'da migratsiya qilish — 10 replika = 10 parallel migratsiya. Migratsiyani alohida Job'da qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Sidecar har pod'ga CPU/memory narx qo'shadi (1000 pod x 50Mi = 50Gi). Shu sabab service mesh'lar sidecar'siz (Istio Ambient) yo'lga o'tmoqda; sidecar'ni faqat haqiqatan pod'ga bog'liq vazifa uchun ishlating.

33267.a:
**Qisqa javob:** RollingUpdate'da `maxSurge` — rejadan ortiq bir vaqtda nechta qo'shimcha pod yaratish mumkin; `maxUnavailable` — nechta pod bir vaqtda ishlamay turishi mumkin (default ikkalasi 25%). `minReadySeconds` — pod Ready bo'lgandan keyin necha soniya barqaror turishi kerak, shundan keyingina "available" hisoblanadi.

**Muammo:** 4 replika, yangi versiya start'da 30 soniya keyin crash qiladi. `minReadySeconds` yo'q bo'lsa rollout hammasini tez almashtirib yuboradi va hammasi yiqiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (replicas=4, maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0):**
```
eski: 4   yangi: 0
eski: 4   yangi: 1 (Ready + minReadySeconds kutiladi)
eski: 3   yangi: 1 -> yangi: 2
...
eski: 0   yangi: 4
Hech qachon < 4 available pod bo'lmaydi, maksimum 5 pod.
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  replicas: 4
  minReadySeconds: 15
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 300
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1          # yoki "25%"
      maxUnavailable: 0    # sig'im kamaymasin
```
```bash
kubectl rollout status deploy/api
kubectl get rs -l app=api -w      # eski va yangi RS replika soni jonli
```

| Holat | Tanlov |
|---|---|
| Sig'im zich, kamaymasin | surge=1, unavailable=0 |
| Resurs tanqis | surge=0, unavailable=1 |
| Tez deploy, ko'p replika | surge=25%, unavailable=25% |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `maxSurge: 0` va `maxUnavailable: 0` — taqiqlangan kombinatsiya.
- Readiness probe yo'q bo'lsa barcha parametrlar ma'nosiz — pod darhol "Ready".
- `Recreate` strategiyasi hamma pod'ni o'chirib keyin yaratadi — downtime (lekin RWO volume yoki eski/yangi versiya mos kelmaganda kerak).

**Senior nuqta:** Rolling update faqat "pod ishlayaptimi"ni tekshiradi, "biznes metrika yaxshimi"ni emas. Xavfli o'zgarishlar uchun canary + avtomatik tahlil (Argo Rollouts/Flagger) qo'shing.

33268.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod o'chirilganda bir vaqtda ikki narsa boshlanadi: endpoint'lardan chiqarish va container'ga `preStop` + `SIGTERM`. Ular **parallel** — shuning uchun proxy'lar hali eski pod'ga trafik yuborishi mumkin. 5xx'siz to'xtatish: `preStop` da qisqa kutish, ilova SIGTERM'da yangi so'rov qabul qilmay, borlarini tugatishi, yetarli `terminationGracePeriodSeconds`.

**Muammo:** har deploy paytida bir necha soniya 502/connection reset. Sabab — ilova SIGTERM'da darhol o'ladi, ingress esa hali uni endpoint deb biladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl delete / rollout
   |
   +--> EndpointSlice'dan chiqarish -> kube-proxy/ingress yangilanadi (1-5 s)
   |
   +--> preStop (sleep 5) -> SIGTERM -> ilova drain -> exit 0
                                   \
             terminationGracePeriodSeconds (default 30) o'tsa -> SIGKILL (137)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
  containers:
  - name: api
    lifecycle:
      preStop:
        sleep: { seconds: 5 }        # 1.30+ native; eski: exec ["sleep","5"]
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
```
```go
// Go: SIGTERM'da graceful shutdown
ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)
defer stop()
go srv.ListenAndServe()
<-ctx.Done()
shCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
srv.Shutdown(shCtx) // yangi ulanish yo'q, mavjudlari tugaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shell wrapper (`sh -c "app"`) SIGTERM'ni ilovaga uzatmaydi — `exec` yoki tini ishlating.
- preStop + drain vaqti > grace period bo'lsa SIGKILL.
- Keep-alive ulanishlar: shutdown paytida `Connection: close` qaytaring.

**Senior nuqta:** Graceful shutdown'ni test qiling: load test ostida `kubectl rollout restart` qilib 5xx sonini o'lchang — nol bo'lmaguncha "tayyor" demang.

33269.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PodDisruptionBudget — **ixtiyoriy (voluntary) uzilishlar** paytida (drain, node upgrade, Karpenter consolidation) bir vaqtda nechta pod o'chishi mumkinligini cheklaydi: `minAvailable` yoki `maxUnavailable`. Node yiqilishi kabi majburiy uzilishlardan himoya qilmaydi.

**Muammo:** cluster upgrade'da 3 node bir vaqtda drain bo'ldi, 3 replika'li etcd/Kafka/API'ning hammasi bir vaqtda o'chdi — quorum yo'qoldi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
drain -> Eviction API -> PDB tekshiruvi:
   available(3) - 1 >= minAvailable(2) ?  ha -> evict
                                          yo'q -> 429, keyinroq qayta urinish
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata: { name: api-pdb }
spec:
  maxUnavailable: 1            # replika soni o'zgarsa ham mos
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: api }
  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow   # crash'dagi pod'lar drain'ni to'smasin
```
```bash
kubectl get pdb -A
# ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS = 0 bo'lsa hozir hech bir pod drain qilinmaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `minAvailable: 100%` yoki replika=1 + `minAvailable: 1` — drain abadiy qotadi, upgrade to'xtaydi.
- PDB selector hech bir pod'ga mos kelmasa — himoya yo'q, lekin xato ham yo'q.
- `kubectl delete pod` PDB'ni chetlab o'tadi — faqat Eviction API hurmat qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Platforma standarti: har ko'p replika'li workload uchun `maxUnavailable: 1` PDB, va policy (Kyverno) bilan "drain'ni to'sadigan PDB"larni taqiqlash. Quorum'li tizimlar uchun `maxUnavailable: 1` aniq quorum'ni saqlaydi.

33270.a:
**Qisqa javob:** StatefulSet kafolatlari: **barqaror nom** (`db-0`, `db-1`), **barqaror tarmoq identifikatori** (headless Service orqali `db-0.db.ns.svc`), **har pod'ga o'z PVC'si** (`volumeClaimTemplates`, pod qayta tug'ilsa shu disk qaytadi), **tartibli** yaratish/o'chirish/yangilash.

**Muammo:** PostgreSQL replikasini Deployment bilan qo'ysangiz pod nomi va diski tasodifiy — replika qaysi primary ekanini, qaysi diskda o'z ma'lumoti borligini bilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Headless Service "db" (clusterIP: None)
   db-0.db.prod.svc  -> db-0  -> PVC data-db-0
   db-1.db.prod.svc  -> db-1  -> PVC data-db-1
   db-2.db.prod.svc  -> db-2  -> PVC data-db-2
yaratish: 0 -> 1 -> 2 (oldingisi Ready bo'lganda)
o'chirish/update: 2 -> 1 -> 0
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: db }
spec: { clusterIP: None, selector: { app: db }, ports: [{ port: 5432 }] }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata: { name: db }
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 3
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady   # yoki Parallel
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: db } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: db } }
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: pg
        image: postgres:17
        volumeMounts: [{ name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data }]
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata: { name: data }
    spec:
      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
      storageClassName: gp3
      resources: { requests: { storage: 50Gi } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- StatefulSet replikatsiya, failover, backup **qilmaydi** — bu ilova yoki operator ishi.
- Scale down'da PVC o'chmaydi (default) — pul yeydi, lekin ma'lumotni saqlaydi.
- Node yiqilsa pod avtomatik ko'chmaydi (ikki nusxa xavfi), qo'lda aralashuv yoki non-graceful node shutdown taint kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Production DB uchun xom StatefulSet emas, operator (CloudNativePG, Strimzi) yoki managed servis tanlang — failover, backup, upgrade logikasi u yerda allaqachon sinovdan o'tgan.

33271.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Yaxshi chart: oddiy va hujjatlangan `values.yaml`, `_helpers.tpl` da umumiy nom/label'lar, `values.schema.json` bilan validatsiya, ehtiyotkor hook'lar, `helm lint` + `helm template` + `helm test` va CI'da render natijasini tekshirish.

**Muammo:** 40 ta `if`li chart, hech kim qaysi value nima qilishini bilmaydi, typo (`replicaCount` o'rniga `replicacount`) jimgina e'tiborsiz qolib prod'ga 1 replika ketadi.

**Qanday tuziladi:**
```
chart/
  Chart.yaml             version (chart), appVersion (ilova)
  values.yaml            default'lar + izoh
  values.schema.json     typo va tipni ushlaydi
  templates/
    _helpers.tpl         name, labels, selectorLabels
    deployment.yaml
    tests/test-conn.yaml
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "api.labels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
# templates/deployment.yaml (parcha)
metadata:
  labels: {{- include "api.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  annotations:
    checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ required "replicaCount kerak" .Values.replicaCount }}
```
```bash
helm lint ./chart --strict
helm template t ./chart -f values-prod.yaml | kubeconform -strict -summary
helm upgrade --install api ./chart --atomic --wait
helm test api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hook (`pre-upgrade` migratsiya Job) — muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa release qotadi; `hook-delete-policy` va timeout qo'ying.
- `lookup` funksiyasi `helm template`/GitOps'da ishlamaydi.
- Secret'ni values'ga yozish — Git'da ochiq qoladi; External Secrets ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Chart — API: `values` nomlarini o'zgartirish breaking change. SemVer bilan versiyalang, CHANGELOG yuriting va chart'ni minimal saqlang — har `if` keyingi yil sizga qimmatga tushadi.

33272.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Job — bir martalik vazifa: `backoffLimit` (qayta urinish soni), `activeDeadlineSeconds` (umumiy vaqt chegarasi), `completions`/`parallelism`, `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` (tozalash). CronJob — jadval bo'yicha Job yaratadi: `concurrencyPolicy` (Allow/Forbid/Replace), `startingDeadlineSeconds`, `timeZone`, history limit'lar.

**Muammo:** tungi hisobot Job'i 2 soat davom etdi, keyingi jadval kelib ikkinchisi ham ishga tushdi — ikkalasi bir jadvalni yangilab, ma'lumot buzildi. Yoki Job abadiy qayta urinib, minglab tugagan pod qoldirdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CronJob "0 2 * * *" --> Job (har kuni) --> Pod(lar)
   concurrencyPolicy: Forbid -> oldingi tugamagan bo'lsa yangisi o'tkazib yuboriladi
Job: pod fail -> backoff (10s, 20s, 40s ... 6 min max) -> backoffLimit -> Failed
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: report }
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  timeZone: "Asia/Tashkent"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 600
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 3
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers:
          - name: report
            image: ghcr.io/acme/report:2.1.0
```
```bash
kubectl create job --from=cronjob/report report-manual   # qo'lda ishga tushirish
kubectl get jobs; kubectl logs job/report-manual
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Job "kamida bir marta" ishlaydi, ba'zan ikki marta — vazifa **idempotent** bo'lishi shart.
- `restartPolicy: OnFailure` — pod ichida restart, log'lar yo'qolishi mumkin; `Never` debug uchun qulayroq.
- CronJob controller 100 dan ortiq o'tkazib yuborilgan jadvalni ko'rsa Job yaratmaydi.
- Indexed Job (`completionMode: Indexed`) bo'lak-bo'lak parallel ishlash uchun — `JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX`.

**Senior nuqta:** Job muvaffaqiyatsizligini kuzating (`kube_job_status_failed`) va "oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli ishga tushish" vaqti bo'yicha alert qo'ying — CronJob jimgina ishlamay qolishi eng ko'p kech aniqlanadigan muammo.

33273.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Blue-green** — ikki to'liq muhit (blue = hozirgi, green = yangi), test qilingach Service selector'ni bir lahzada green'ga almashtirish, muammo bo'lsa qaytarish. **Canary** — trafikning kichik qismini (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) yangi versiyaga yuborish va metrikaga qarab davom etish yoki qaytarish. Amalda Argo Rollouts yoki Flagger + ingress/mesh/Gateway API trafik bo'lishi.

**Muammo:** rolling update hamma foydalanuvchini sekin-asta yangi versiyaga o'tkazadi, lekin xato 50% pod yangilanganda sezilsa, zarar katta. Kichik qismda sinab ko'rish yoki darhol qaytarish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Blue-green:
  Service -> selector version=blue  (100%)
  green deploy + smoke test
  Service -> selector version=green (100%), blue zaxirada

Canary:
  Ingress/Gateway: stable 90% | canary 10%
     | Prometheus: error rate, p99
     v  yaxshi -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% ; yomon -> 0% (abort)
```

**Amalda (Argo Rollouts):**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  replicas: 10
  strategy:
    canary:
      canaryService: api-canary
      stableService: api-stable
      trafficRouting:
        nginx: { stableIngress: api }
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: error-rate }] }
      - setWeight: 50
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
```
```bash
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch
kubectl argo rollouts abort api
kubectl argo rollouts promote api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Replika soni orqali canary (9 eski + 1 yangi) — trafik ulushi aniq emas, sticky session'da buziladi.
- DB sxema o'zgarishi: ikki versiya bir vaqtda ishlaydi — migratsiya backward-compatible bo'lishi shart (expand/contract).
- Blue-green 2x resurs talab qiladi.
- Metrikasiz canary — shunchaki sekin rolling update.

**Senior nuqta:** Canary'ning qiymati avtomatik tahlilda: SLO metrikalari (error rate, p99) bo'yicha AnalysisTemplate va avtomatik abort. Kichik trafikli servislarda statistik ahamiyatga yetish uchun sintetik trafik yoki uzunroq bosqich kerak.

33274.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **CRD** (CustomResourceDefinition) — Kubernetes API'ga yangi resurs turini qo'shadi (masalan `kind: PostgresCluster`). **Operator** — shu resursni watch qilib, reconcile loop orqali murakkab ilovani boshqaradigan controller (o'rnatish, backup, failover, upgrade). O'zingiz yozish — kamdan-kam kerak: avval tayyor operator yoki Helm yetarlimi, tekshiring.

**Muammo:** PostgreSQL failover, backup, versiya yangilash — odam qiladigan runbook. Operator shu "operator bilimini" kodga aylantiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl apply PostgresCluster(instances: 3)
        |
        v
apiserver (CRD schema validatsiya) -> etcd
        |
        | watch
        v
Operator reconcile():
   hozirgi holat?  StatefulSet, Service, Secret, backup CronJob
   farq bormi?     yaratish / yangilash
   status yozish   .status.phase=Ready
   (xato -> requeue, keyinroq yana)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get crd | grep postgres
kubectl explain postgrescluster.spec
kubectl get postgresclusters -A
# O'zingiz yozsangiz: kubebuilder / operator-sdk (Go, controller-runtime)
kubebuilder init --domain acme.io --repo github.com/acme/op
kubebuilder create api --group app --version v1 --kind Cache
```
```go
func (r *CacheReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
    var c appv1.Cache
    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &c); err != nil {
        return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
    }
    // desired StatefulSet'ni quril, CreateOrUpdate, status yangila
    return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: time.Minute}, nil
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Reconcile idempotent bo'lmasa — har chaqiruvda takroriy resurs yaratiladi.
- Finalizer'ni noto'g'ri boshqarish — resurs "Terminating"da abadiy qotadi.
- CRD versiyasini o'zgartirish (v1alpha1 -> v1) conversion webhook talab qiladi.
- Operator cluster-admin huquqi bilan — katta hujum yuzasi.

**Senior nuqta:** Operator yozish = uzoq muddatli dasturiy mahsulotga egalik (upgrade, test, on-call). Faqat sizning domeningizga xos, takroriy va avtomatlashtirilmagan operatsion bilim bo'lsa yozing; aks holda CloudNativePG, Strimzi, cert-manager kabi yetuk operator'lardan foydalaning.

33275.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitOps — Git yagona haqiqat manbai; cluster ichidagi agent (Argo CD yoki Flux) Git'ni kuzatib, cluster holatini unga moslab **tortib oladi (pull)** va drift'ni tuzatadi. Push-based CD'da esa CI pipeline cluster credential'i bilan `kubectl/helm` ni o'zi ishga tushiradi.

**Muammo:** CI'da prod kubeconfig saqlanadi (sizib chiqsa — cluster sizniki emas), kimdir qo'lda o'zgartirsa hech kim bilmaydi, "prod'da hozir nima bor?" savoliga aniq javob yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Push:  dev -> Git -> CI --(kubeconfig, tashqaridan)--> cluster

Pull (GitOps):
  dev -> app repo -> CI: test, image build, push
                        \-> config repo: image tag PR
  cluster ichida: Argo CD --poll/webhook--> config repo
                  diff(Git, live) -> sync -> self-heal
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata: { name: api-prod, namespace: argocd }
spec:
  project: payments
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/acme/deploy
    path: apps/api/overlays/prod
    targetRevision: main
  destination: { server: https://kubernetes.default.svc, namespace: prod }
  syncPolicy:
    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }
    syncOptions: [ServerSideApply=true]
```
```bash
argocd app get api-prod        # Sync/Health status
argocd app diff api-prod
flux get kustomizations        # Flux ekvivalenti
```

| | Push CD | GitOps (pull) |
|---|---|---|
| Credential | CI'da | cluster ichida |
| Drift | aniqlanmaydi | aniqlanadi/tuzatiladi |
| Audit | CI log | Git tarixi |
| Rollback | qayta deploy | `git revert` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'lar Git'da ochiq — SOPS, Sealed Secrets yoki External Secrets kerak.
- `prune: true` noto'g'ri path bilan — resurslar o'chib ketadi.
- Bir resursni ikki Application boshqarishi — doimiy sync urushi.

**Senior nuqta:** GitOps CI'ni CD'dan ajratadi va xavfsizlik chegarasini yaxshilaydi, lekin yangi kritik komponent qo'shadi: Argo CD'ning o'zi HA, RBAC (AppProject) va zaxiraga muhtoj — u ham "cluster-admin" darajasidagi tizim.

33276.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Xavfsiz upgrade tartibi: (1) deprecated API'larni topib tuzatish, (2) add-on'larning mosligini tekshirish, (3) avval non-prod'da sinov, (4) control plane'ni bitta minor versiyaga ko'tarish, (5) add-on'lar (CNI, CoreDNS, kube-proxy, CSI), (6) node'larni rolling almashtirish PDB bilan, (7) monitoring va rollback rejasi. Minor versiyani sakrab o'tib bo'lmaydi.

**Muammo:** EKS 1.30 -> 1.31: Helm chart'dagi eski API olib tashlangan bo'lsa deploy'lar sinadi; control plane'ni ortga qaytarib bo'lmaydi — bu bir tomonlama eshik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
[tayyorgarlik]  pluto/kubent: deprecated API, add-on matrix
      v
[stage cluster] upgrade + e2e test
      v
[prod CP]       1.30 -> 1.31 (managed, ~10-20 daq, API qisqa uzilishi mumkin)
      v
[add-on'lar]    vpc-cni, coredns, kube-proxy, ebs-csi
      v
[node'lar]      yangi node group / Karpenter drift -> drain (PDB) -> eski o'chadi
      v
[tekshiruv]     SLO, error rate, pod restart
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis
pluto detect-helm -o wide --target-versions k8s=v1.31.0
kubent
aws eks describe-addon-versions --kubernetes-version 1.31 --addon-name coredns
aws eks update-cluster-version --name prod --kubernetes-version 1.31
aws eks update-nodegroup-version --cluster-name prod --nodegroup-name ng-1
kubectl get nodes -L node.kubernetes.io/instance-type   # VERSION ustuni
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kubelet control plane'dan oldin bo'lishi mumkin emas; skew policy: kubelet CP'dan 3 minorgacha orqada bo'lishi mumkin (1.28+).
- PDB'lar noto'g'ri (ALLOWED=0) — node drain qotadi.
- Webhook'lar (admission) yangi versiyada ishlamasa — butun API yozish to'xtaydi.
- EKS'da standard support tugasa extended support qo'shimcha pul oladi — rejalashtiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng xavfsiz yondashuv — blue/green cluster upgrade: yangi cluster yaratib, GitOps bilan workload'larni deploy qilib, trafikni DNS/LB orqali bosqichma-bosqich ko'chirish. In-place upgrade arzonroq, lekin qaytarib bo'lmaydi. Yiliga ~3 minor chiqadi — upgrade'ni muntazam, zerikarli jarayonga aylantiring.

33277.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kube-scheduler har Pending pod uchun ikki bosqich bajaradi: **filter** (qaysi node'lar umuman mos: resurs request'lari sig'adimi, taint/toleration, nodeSelector/affinity, PVC zonasi, port) va **score** (mos node'larni baholash: resurs balansi, affinity afzalligi, topology spread, image allaqachon bor). Eng yuqori ball olgan node'ga pod **bind** qilinadi.

**Muammo:** pod "Pending" — nega? Scheduler mantiqini bilmasangiz, `describe`dagi "0/5 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu, 2 node(s) had untolerated taint" xabarini o'qiy olmaysiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pending pod queue
     |
     v
Filter (plugin'lar): NodeResourcesFit, TaintToleration, NodeAffinity,
                     VolumeBinding, PodTopologySpread ...
     |  5 node -> 2 mos
     v
Score: LeastAllocated/MostAllocated, ImageLocality, InterPodAffinity ...
     |  node-a: 82, node-b: 64
     v
Bind -> pod.spec.nodeName = node-a -> kubelet ishga tushiradi
Mos node yo'q -> PostFilter (preemption) yoki Pending
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | sed -n '/Events/,$p'
# FailedScheduling: 0/5 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient memory,
#   3 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector.
kubectl describe node worker-1 | grep -A8 "Allocated resources"
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeName}'
```
O'qish: xabar har node nega rad etilganini sanaydi — eng katta son asosiy sabab.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scheduler **request**'larga qaraydi, haqiqiy foydalanishga emas — node "bo'sh" ko'rinsa ham pod sig'maydi.
- Request yo'q pod'lar (BestEffort) istalgan joyga tushadi va node'ni haddan ortiq yuklaydi.
- DaemonSet pod'lari ham resurs oladi — allocatable hisobida unutilmasin.

**Senior nuqta:** Scheduler faqat joylashtirish vaqtida qaror qiladi; keyin cluster holati o'zgarsa pod'lar ko'chmaydi. Balansni qayta tiklash uchun descheduler yoki Karpenter consolidation kerak.

33278.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **nodeSelector** — oddiy majburiy label moslik (`disktype=ssd`). **Node affinity** — kengroq ifoda: majburiy (`required...`) yoki afzal (`preferred...`, vazn bilan), `In/NotIn/Exists` operatorlari. **Taint/toleration** — teskari yo'nalish: node "meni ishlatma" deydi, faqat tegishli toleration'li pod'lar tusha oladi.

**Farqning mohiyati:** affinity pod'ni node'ga **tortadi**, taint pod'larni node'dan **itaradi**. GPU node'ni faqat ML pod'lari uchun ajratish uchun ikkalasi kerak: taint (boshqalar tushmasin) + affinity (ML pod'i aynan shu yerga borsin).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GPU node: label gpu=true, taint gpu=true:NoSchedule
  web pod (toleration yo'q)        -> rad etiladi
  ml pod (toleration bor)          -> tusha oladi, lekin boshqa joyga ham
  ml pod (toleration + affinity)   -> faqat GPU node
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl label node gpu-1 gpu=true
kubectl taint node gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint node gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule-     # olib tashlash
```
```yaml
spec:
  tolerations:
  - { key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: "true", effect: NoSchedule }
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - { key: gpu, operator: In, values: ["true"] }
      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 50
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
          - { key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone, operator: In, values: [eu-west-1a] }
```
Taint effektlari: `NoSchedule` (yangi tushmaydi), `PreferNoSchedule` (iloji bo'lsa), `NoExecute` (borlarini ham chiqaradi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Toleration "ruxsat" beradi, "majburlamaydi" — affinity'siz pod oddiy node'ga ham tushadi.
- `IgnoredDuringExecution` — label keyin o'zgarsa ishlab turgan pod qoladi.
- `NoExecute` taint qo'shish ishlab turgan pod'larni darhol chiqaradi — prod'da ehtiyot bo'ling.

**Senior nuqta:** Node pool'larni maqsad bo'yicha ajratish (system, general, GPU, spot) taint + label standartiga asoslansin; Karpenter NodePool'larda aynan shu ifodalar ishlatiladi.

33279.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **emptyDir** — pod umri davomidagi vaqtinchalik papka (pod o'chsa yo'qoladi). **hostPath** — node faylini pod'ga ochadi (xavfli, deyarli faqat tizim agentlari uchun). **configMap/secret** — konfiguratsiya va maxfiy ma'lumotni fayl qilib berish. **PVC** — doimiy disk, pod o'chsa ham saqlanadi.

**Muammo:** container fayl tizimi efemer — container restart bo'lsa yozilgan narsa yo'qoladi. Qaysi ma'lumot qancha yashashi kerakligiga qarab volume turi tanlanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Umr:  container < emptyDir (pod) < PVC (pod'dan mustaqil)
            container restart -> emptyDir saqlanadi
            pod o'chdi        -> emptyDir yo'q, PVC bor
hostPath: node diski -> pod boshqa node'ga ko'chsa boshqa ma'lumot
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
volumes:
- name: cache
  emptyDir: { sizeLimit: 1Gi }          # medium: Memory -> tmpfs (RAM'dan hisoblanadi)
- name: cfg
  configMap: { name: api-config }
- name: tls
  secret: { secretName: api-tls, defaultMode: 0400 }
- name: data
  persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: api-data }
- name: logs                             # faqat log agent DaemonSet uchun
  hostPath: { path: /var/log, type: Directory }
```
```bash
kubectl get pvc
kubectl exec api-x -- df -h /data
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `hostPath` — konteynerdan node'ga chiqish yo'li (masalan `/` yoki `/var/run/containerd.sock` mount qilinsa node to'liq egallanadi). Pod Security `baseline` uni taqiqlaydi.
- `sizeLimit`siz emptyDir node diskini to'ldirib eviction keltirib chiqaradi.
- `emptyDir.medium: Memory` pod memory limit'iga kiradi — OOM.

**Senior nuqta:** Stateless servislar faqat emptyDir/configMap/secret ishlatsin; PVC — stateful komponentlar uchun ongli qaror. Har PVC — backup, zona bog'liqligi va pul degani.

33280.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ReadWriteOnce (RWO)** — bitta **node** o'qib-yoza oladi (o'sha node'dagi bir nechta pod ham). **ReadOnlyMany (ROX)** — ko'p node faqat o'qiydi. **ReadWriteMany (RWX)** — ko'p node o'qib-yozadi (NFS, EFS, CephFS, Azure Files). **ReadWriteOncePod (RWOP)** — faqat bitta **pod** (1.29+ GA).

**Muammo:** Deployment 3 replika, EBS RWO volume — 2- va 3-pod boshqa node'da "Multi-Attach error" bilan ContainerCreating'da qotadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Block disk (EBS, PD, Azure Disk) -> odatda faqat RWO/RWOP
   node-a: pod1, pod2  OK (RWO)    node-b: pod3  Multi-Attach error
File storage (EFS, NFS, Filestore) -> RWX
   node-a, node-b, node-c hammasi mount qiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata: { name: shared-uploads }
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteMany]
  storageClassName: efs-sc
  resources: { requests: { storage: 100Gi } }
```
```bash
kubectl get pv -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,MODES:.spec.accessModes,SC:.spec.storageClassName
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -i attach
```

| Mode | Misol backend | Ishlatish |
|---|---|---|
| RWO | EBS gp3 | DB, StatefulSet |
| RWOP | EBS + CSI | qat'iy yagona yozuvchi |
| RWX | EFS, NFS | umumiy fayllar |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RWO "bitta pod" emas, "bitta node" — ikki pod bir node'da bir diskka yozib ma'lumotni buzishi mumkin; kerak bo'lsa RWOP.
- Access mode — so'rov; backend qo'llamasa PVC Pending qoladi.
- RWX tarmoq fayl tizimi sekinroq va DB uchun mos emas (lock, fsync semantikasi).

**Senior nuqta:** RWX'ga ehtiyoj ko'pincha arxitektura signali: umumiy fayllarni object storage (S3)ga ko'chirish odatda arzonroq, tezroq va masshtablanuvchan.

33281.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Liveness** — "ilova tirikmi?" yo'q bo'lsa kubelet container'ni **restart** qiladi. **Readiness** — "trafik olishga tayyormi?" yo'q bo'lsa pod Service endpoint'laridan **chiqariladi** (restart yo'q). **Startup** — sekin ishga tushadigan ilova uchun: u muvaffaqiyatli bo'lguncha liveness/readiness ishlamaydi.

**Muammo:** Java ilova 90 soniyada ko'tariladi, liveness 30 soniyadan keyin tekshiradi va uni o'ldiradi — abadiy CrashLoop. Yoki liveness DB'ni tekshiradi, DB sekinlashdi — hamma pod'lar bir vaqtda restart bo'ldi, to'liq outage.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
start -> startupProbe (failureThreshold x period = max start vaqti)
            | OK
            v
     livenessProbe  -- fail N marta --> restart container
     readinessProbe -- fail --> endpoint'dan chiqarish, OK -> qaytarish
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
containers:
- name: api
  startupProbe:
    httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
    periodSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 30          # 150 s gacha start
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }   # faqat jarayon ichki holati
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }     # bog'liqliklar, warmup
    periodSeconds: 5
```
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -E "Liveness|Readiness|Unhealthy"
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Liveness'da tashqi bog'liqlik (DB, Redis) tekshirish — kaskadli restart. Liveness faqat "jarayon qotib qolmaganmi".
- Readiness'ni ham juda qattiq qilish — DB sekinlashsa hamma pod chiqadi, 503.
- Liveness va readiness bir xil endpoint, bir xil threshold — ma'nosi yo'qoladi.
- Og'ir probe (har 1 s, DB query) — o'zi yuk yaratadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p servislar uchun liveness umuman kerak emas yoki juda yumshoq bo'lsin; deadlock'lar real bo'lsa qo'ying. Readiness esa graceful shutdown va rollout'ning asosi — uni har doim qo'ying.

33282.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `topologySpreadConstraints` — pod'larni domenlar (zona, node) bo'yicha **teng taqsimlaydi**: `maxSkew` (eng ko'p va eng kam domen orasidagi farq), `topologyKey`, `whenUnsatisfiable`. `podAntiAffinity` — "shu label'li pod bor joyga tushma" qoidasi; qat'iy yoki afzal. Spread — zamonaviy va moslashuvchan, anti-affinity — oddiy "bir node'ga bittadan".

**Muammo:** 6 replika, hammasi bitta AZ'ga tushdi. AZ yiqildi — servis to'liq to'xtadi, garchi "6 replika" bo'lsa ham.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
maxSkew=1, topologyKey=zone
  zone-a: 2   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 2   -> OK
  zone-a: 3   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 1   -> skew 2, rad etiladi
anti-affinity (required, hostname): har node'da max 1 pod
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
    matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash]       # har revision alohida hisoblansin
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  affinity:
    podAntiAffinity:
      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        podAffinityTerm:
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```
```bash
kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide
kubectl get nodes -L topology.kubernetes.io/zone
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `required` anti-affinity + replika > node soni = Pending pod'lar.
- `DoNotSchedule` + bitta zonada sig'im tugasa — rollout qotadi.
- Rolling update paytida eski/yangi pod'lar aralashib skew'ni buzadi — `matchLabelKeys` bilan hal qilinadi.
- Spread faqat scheduling vaqtida; keyin muvozanat buzilsa descheduler kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Zona bo'yicha spread — HA'ning asosi, lekin cross-AZ trafik pul turadi (AWS'da GB uchun). Topology-aware routing (`trafficDistribution: PreferClose`) bilan birga ishlating.

33283.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **HPA** — pod sonini metrikaga (CPU, memory, custom) qarab o'zgartiradi. **VPA** — pod'ning request/limit hajmini o'zgartiradi. **Cluster Autoscaler / Karpenter** — Pending pod'lar uchun node qo'shadi, bo'sh node'larni olib tashlaydi. Zanjir: yuk oshdi -> HPA pod qo'shdi -> pod sig'madi (Pending) -> Karpenter node qo'shdi.

**Muammo:** HPA pod qo'shdi, lekin node yo'q — pod'lar Pending, yuk baribir eski pod'larda. Yoki HPA va VPA ikkalasi CPU'ga qarab bir-biriga qarshi ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
trafik ^ -> CPU 80% -> HPA: replicas 4 -> 8
                          |
                          v
                 4 pod Pending (joy yo'q)
                          |
                          v
         Karpenter: mos instance turini tanlab node yaratadi (~1 daq)
                          |
                          v
                 pod'lar Running -> CPU tushadi
VPA (alohida): tarixga qarab request'ni to'g'rilaydi (ko'pincha recommend rejimi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 } }
  behavior:
    scaleDown: { stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 }
```
```bash
kubectl get hpa api -w          # TARGETS: 85%/70%
kubectl describe hpa api        # sabablar, "unable to get metrics"
kubectl get nodeclaims          # Karpenter yaratgan node'lar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HPA CPU'si **request**ga nisbatan hisoblanadi — request yo'q bo'lsa HPA ishlamaydi.
- HPA va VPA ikkalasi bir xil metrika (CPU) bo'yicha `Auto` rejimda — urush. VPA'ni `Off`/recommend rejimida ishlating yoki HPA custom metrikada bo'lsin.
- metrics-server yo'q — `<unknown>/70%`.
- Node qo'shish 1-3 daqiqa; keskin pik uchun overprovisioning (past prioritetli "joy band qiluvchi" pod'lar) kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Autoscaling — kaskad tizim, har bo'g'inning kechikishi qo'shiladi. Bashoratli yuk uchun jadval (KEDA cron), keskin yuk uchun headroom, va scaleDown'ni sekin qiling — tebranish (flapping) xarajat va latency'ni oshiradi.

33284.a:
**Qisqa javob:** KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — HPA ustiga qurilgan va tashqi event manbalari (Kafka lag, SQS/RabbitMQ navbat uzunligi, Prometheus query, cron) bo'yicha masshtablaydi, **0 gacha** tushirish va 0 dan ko'tarishni qo'llaydi. HPA'dan yaxshiroq: navbat/event asosidagi worker'lar va bo'sh vaqtda nolga tushirish kerak bo'lganda.

**Muammo:** Kafka consumer CPU'si past, lekin lag 2 million xabar — CPU bo'yicha HPA hech narsa qilmaydi. Yoki tunda ishlamaydigan worker'lar 24/7 resurs yeydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
KEDA operator --so'raydi--> Kafka (lag), SQS (uzunlik), Prometheus
     |
     +--> 0 <-> 1 : KEDA o'zi (activation)
     +--> 1 <-> N : KEDA yaratgan HPA (external metrics API orqali)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata: { name: orders-worker }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-worker }
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 50
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  triggers:
  - type: kafka
    metadata:
      bootstrapServers: kafka:9092
      consumerGroup: orders
      topic: orders
      lagThreshold: "1000"          # har replika uchun maqsad lag
    authenticationRef: { name: kafka-auth }
```
```bash
kubectl get scaledobject
kubectl get hpa                    # keda-hpa-orders-worker
kubectl describe scaledobject orders-worker
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kafka'da replika soni partition sonidan ko'p bo'lsa ortiqchalari bo'sh turadi.
- 0 dan ko'tarilish — cold start (image pull, warmup) kechikishi; latency-sezgir API uchun min 0 qo'ymang.
- Bitta resurs uchun ham KEDA ScaledObject, ham qo'lda HPA — ikki HPA urushi.
- Trigger autentifikatsiyasi uchun secret'lar — TriggerAuthentication + workload identity bilan bering.

**Senior nuqta:** Asinxron worker'lar uchun to'g'ri signal — "bajarilmagan ish hajmi" (lag, navbat), CPU emas. KEDA shu signalni beradi; lekin downstream (DB) sig'imini ham hisobga olib `maxReplicaCount` ni cheklang, aks holda autoscaling DB'ni yiqitadi.

33285.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **StorageClass** — disk "turi" va uni qanday yaratish (provisioner, parametrlar: gp3, IOPS, shifrlash). **Dynamic provisioning** — PVC yaratilganda CSI driver avtomatik PV (haqiqiy disk) yaratadi. **reclaimPolicy** — PVC o'chirilganda disk bilan nima bo'ladi: `Delete` (disk o'chadi) yoki `Retain` (disk qoladi, qo'lda tozalash).

**Muammo:** kimdir test namespace'ni o'chirdi, unda prod DB'ning PVC'si bor edi va reclaimPolicy `Delete` — disk ham yo'qoldi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PVC (50Gi, sc=gp3-enc) --> CSI provisioner --> AWS'da EBS yaratadi
        |                                         |
        +---------- bind <------- PV (avtomatik) -+
PVC o'chdi -> reclaimPolicy:
   Delete -> EBS o'chadi
   Retain -> PV "Released", EBS saqlanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: gp3-enc
  annotations: { storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" }
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
parameters: { type: gp3, encrypted: "true", iops: "3000" }
reclaimPolicy: Retain
allowVolumeExpansion: true
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
```
```bash
kubectl get sc
kubectl get pv,pvc -A
kubectl patch pv pvc-123 -p '{"spec":{"persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy":"Retain"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `volumeBindingMode: Immediate` — disk pod'dan oldin tasodifiy zonada yaratiladi, pod boshqa zonada bo'lsa joylanmaydi. `WaitForFirstConsumer` ishlating.
- Default StorageClass ikkita bo'lsa — kutilmagan natija.
- Disk hajmini kamaytirib bo'lmaydi, faqat kengaytirish (`allowVolumeExpansion`).
- `in-tree` provisioner'lar (`kubernetes.io/aws-ebs`) eskirgan — CSI driver ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Muhim ma'lumot uchun `Retain` + VolumeSnapshot asosidagi backup (Velero/CSI snapshot). reclaimPolicy — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, backup emas.

33286.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ResourceQuota** — namespace bo'yicha jami cheklov (umumiy CPU/memory request/limit, pod soni, PVC, LoadBalancer soni). **LimitRange** — namespace ichidagi har bir container/pod uchun default va min/max qiymatlar (request yozilmasa avtomatik qo'yadi).

**Muammo:** bitta jamoa xato bilan 500 replika yaratdi va butun cluster sig'imini egalladi; yoki request yozilmagan pod'lar scheduler'ni aldab node'larni haddan ortiq yukladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
namespace team-a
  ResourceQuota: requests.cpu <= 20, requests.memory <= 40Gi, pods <= 100
  LimitRange: default request cpu=100m mem=128Mi, max mem=4Gi
pod yaratish -> LimitRange default qo'shadi -> Quota yig'indini tekshiradi
             -> oshsa: 403 "exceeded quota"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata: { name: team-a, namespace: team-a }
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "20"
    requests.memory: 40Gi
    limits.memory: 80Gi
    pods: "100"
    services.loadbalancers: "2"
    persistentvolumeclaims: "20"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata: { name: defaults, namespace: team-a }
spec:
  limits:
  - type: Container
    defaultRequest: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
    default: { memory: 256Mi }
    max: { memory: 4Gi }
```
```bash
kubectl describe quota -n team-a     # Used / Hard
kubectl describe limitrange -n team-a
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Quota `requests.cpu` bor, lekin LimitRange yo'q — request yozilmagan pod'lar rad etiladi ("must specify requests.cpu").
- Quota xatosi Deployment'da emas, ReplicaSet event'larida ko'rinadi — `kubectl describe rs`.
- LimitRange faqat yangi pod'larga ta'sir qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Multi-tenant cluster'da har namespace yaratilganda quota + LimitRange + NetworkPolicy shablonini avtomatik qo'ying (Kyverno generate yoki namespace operator). Quota'lar — "fair share" va xarajat nazoratining birinchi qatlami.

33287.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CPU limit CFS quota orqali ishlaydi: har 100ms davrda container faqat `limit` qadar CPU vaqt oladi, tugasa davr oxirigacha **throttle** (to'xtatiladi) — hatto node'da bo'sh CPU bo'lsa ham. Shu sabab ko'p jamoalar CPU **request** qo'yadi (scheduling va adolatli taqsimot uchun), lekin CPU **limit** qo'ymaydi; memory limit esa qo'yiladi.

**Muammo:** p99 latency 200ms, o'rtacha CPU 30%. Sabab — ko'p goroutine/thread'li ilova 100ms davrning boshida quota'ni tugatadi va qolgan ~80ms kutadi. Grafikda CPU past, lekin so'rovlar sekin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
limit = 1 CPU, 4 thread parallel ishlaydi
davr 100ms:
 0ms ----25ms [quota tugadi: 4 x 25 = 100ms CPU] ...... 100ms
          |<----------- throttled 75ms ---------->|
So'rov shu paytda kelsa +75ms kechikish.
CPU request esa cgroup cpu.weight -> faqat raqobatda ulush, bo'sh CPU'ni olish mumkin.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# throttling bormi?
kubectl exec api-x -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat
# nr_periods 12000  nr_throttled 3400  throttled_usec 98000000
```
```promql
rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{pod=~"api.*"}[5m])
/ rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{pod=~"api.*"}[5m])
```
```yaml
resources:
  requests: { cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi }
  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }          # CPU limit yo'q
```
Go uchun: `GOMAXPROCS`ni CPU request/limit'ga moslang (Go 1.25+ cgroup limitini avtomatik hisobga oladi, eski versiyada `automaxprocs`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CPU limitsiz + request'siz = "noisy neighbour" — request majburiy.
- Guaranteed QoS (request=limit) kerak bo'lsa (CPU pinning, `static` CPU manager) — limit qo'yiladi; bu ongli istisno.
- Multi-tenant cluster'da limit'siz ishlash adolatni faqat request'larga tayantiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Qaror o'lchovga asoslansin: throttling metrikasini kuzating. Latency-sezgir servislar uchun CPU limitni olib tashlash odatda p99'ni yaxshilaydi; memory esa siqib bo'lmaydigan resurs — uning limiti doim bo'lsin.

33288.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kubelet node'da resurs (memory, disk/nodefs, imagefs, inode, PID) **eviction threshold**'dan pastga tushsa, pod'larni chiqaradi. Tartib: avval request'dan ortiq ishlatayotganlar, ular ichida past prioritetlilar va eng ko'p "ortiqcha" ishlatganlar. Amalda: BestEffort -> Burstable (request'dan oshganlar) -> Guaranteed oxirida.

**Muammo:** node'da memory tugay boshladi, kubelet ulgurmasa kernel OOM killer kutilmagan jarayonni (hatto kubelet'ni) o'ldiradi. Eviction — boshqariladigan, oldindan bo'shatish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
memory.available < 100Mi (hard)  -> darhol evict
memory.available < 500Mi 1m30s (soft) -> grace bilan evict
node condition: MemoryPressure=True -> taint node.kubernetes.io/memory-pressure:NoSchedule
tanlash: usage > request ?  -> priority -> (usage - request) eng katta
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe node worker-2 | grep -A6 Conditions   # MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed | grep Evicted
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -i "evicted\|The node was low"
```
```yaml
# KubeletConfiguration
evictionHard:
  memory.available: "200Mi"
  nodefs.available: "10%"
  imagefs.available: "15%"
  nodefs.inodesFree: "5%"
systemReserved: { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi }
kubeReserved:   { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Evict bo'lgan pod'lar `Failed/Evicted` holatda qoladi — tozalash kerak (controller qayta yaratadi, bu boshqa pod).
- `systemReserved/kubeReserved` yo'q — tizim jarayonlari va pod'lar bir xotirani talashadi, node NotReady.
- Container OOMKilled (cgroup limit) va node eviction — boshqa-boshqa hodisa; birinchisi pod ichida restart, ikkinchisi pod'ni node'dan chiqarish.

**Senior nuqta:** Eviction'ning asosiy sababi — request'lar haqiqatdan past. Request'larni real foydalanishga (VPA tavsiyasi, p95) yaqinlashtiring; shunda scheduler to'g'ri joylaydi va eviction kamdan-kam bo'ladi.

33289.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pending pod'larni kamaytirish va bin-packing'ni yaxshilash: request'larni real foydalanishga moslash (VPA tavsiyasi), node turlarini xilma-xil qilish (Karpenter keng instance ro'yxati), consolidation (bo'sh node'larni yig'ish), haddan qattiq affinity/spread qoidalarini yumshatish, descheduler va kerak bo'lsa scheduler profilini `MostAllocated` ga o'zgartirish.

**Muammo:** cluster'da 40% CPU "band" (request bo'yicha), lekin haqiqiy foydalanish 15%. Shu bilan birga yangi pod'lar Pending. Pul ketyapti, sig'im yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Muammo manbalari:
 1. request >> usage            -> "havo" band qilingan
 2. fragmentatsiya              -> har node'da 300m bo'sh, pod 500m so'raydi
 3. qattiq qoidalar             -> required anti-affinity, DoNotSchedule
 4. katta/kichik node nomuvofiq  -> 30Gi pod 16Gi node'ga sig'maydi
Yechim zanjiri:
 rightsizing -> consolidation -> moslashuvchan node turlari -> descheduler
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=FailedScheduling | tail
kubectl top nodes; kubectl top pods -A --sort-by=cpu
kubectl describe node | grep -A5 "Allocated resources"
```
```promql
# request va haqiqiy foydalanish nisbati
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) by (namespace)
/ sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}) by (namespace)
```
```yaml
# Karpenter NodePool
spec:
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized
    consolidateAfter: 5m
  template:
    spec:
      requirements:
      - { key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-category, operator: In, values: [c, m, r] }
      - { key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type, operator: In, values: [spot, on-demand] }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Agressiv consolidation — pod'lar tez-tez ko'chadi; PDB va graceful shutdown bo'lmasa xatolar.
- Hamma narsani bitta katta node turiga moslash — spot taqchilligida sig'im yo'qoladi.
- Request'ni juda past qilish — eviction va throttling.

**Senior nuqta:** Bin-packing — xarajat va ishonchlilik orasidagi trade-off: 85% to'ldirilgan cluster'da node yo'qolsa pod'lar boradigan joy yo'q. Headroom va consolidation darajasini SLO'ga qarab ongli tanlang va "cost per request" bilan o'lchang.

33290.a:
**Qisqa javob:** etcd — cluster'ning yagona holat bazasi: barcha obyektlar (Deployment, Secret, ConfigMap, RBAC) shu yerda. U yo'qolsa yoki buzilsa cluster "xotirasini" yo'qotadi. Himoya: 3/5 a'zoli quorum, tez SSD (past fsync latency), mTLS, encryption at rest, tarmoqdan izolyatsiya va muntazam **snapshot** + tiklashni sinash.

**Muammo:** self-managed cluster'da etcd diski to'ldi yoki buzildi, backup yo'q — barcha manifestlarni qayta yaratish kerak, Secret'lar yo'qolgan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
apiserver --gRPC/mTLS--> etcd-1 (leader)
                           | Raft log replikatsiyasi
                   etcd-2 -+- etcd-3
Yozish: leader -> ko'pchilik (2/3) diskka fsync -> commit
Sekin disk = sekin commit = sekin butun API
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
export ETCDCTL_API=3 ETCDCTL_CACERT=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
  ETCDCTL_CERT=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt ETCDCTL_KEY=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
etcdctl endpoint health --cluster
etcdctl endpoint status --cluster -w table     # leader, DB size, raft index
etcdctl snapshot save /backup/etcd-$(date +%F).db
etcdutl snapshot status /backup/etcd-2026-10-03.db -w table
etcdutl snapshot restore /backup/etcd.db --data-dir /var/lib/etcd-restore
etcdctl defrag --cluster                       # DB fragmentatsiyasi
```
Kuzatish: `etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds` p99 < 10ms, `etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes` quota (default 2GiB, 8GiB gacha tavsiya)ga yaqinlashmasin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DB quota to'lsa etcd `NOSPACE` alarm bilan read-only bo'ladi — butun cluster yozishni to'xtatadi. Compaction + defrag kerak.
- Snapshot shifrlanmagan bo'lsa ichida barcha Secret'lar — backup'ni ham shifrlang va kirishni cheklang.
- Tiklashni hech qachon sinamaslik — backup bor deb o'ylash.
- Managed K8s (EKS/GKE/AKS)'da etcd'ga kirish yo'q — u yerda Velero bilan resurs darajasida backup.

**Senior nuqta:** etcd'ni katta obyektlar va ko'p event bilan to'ldirmang (masalan har sekundda o'zgaradigan CRD status). Etcd sog'lig'i — control plane SLO'si; disk latency birinchi kuzatiladigan metrika.

33291.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CrashLoopBackOff — container qayta-qayta yiqilyapti va kubelet har safar kutish vaqtini oshirib (10s, 20s, 40s ... 5 daq) qayta ishga tushiryapti. Debug tartibi: `describe` (exit code, reason, events) -> `logs --previous` (o'lgan container log'i) -> sababga qarab tuzatish.

**Muammo:** pod RESTARTS ustuni o'sib boryapti, `kubectl logs` bo'sh — chunki yangi container hali hech narsa yozmagan, kerakli log oldingi (o'lgan) container'da.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
start -> crash (exit != 0) -> kubelet kutadi (backoff) -> start -> crash ...
                                  10s -> 20s -> 40s ... max 300s
10 daqiqa barqaror ishlasa backoff qayta 0 ga tushadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pod api-x                        # RESTARTS 7, STATUS CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A10 "Last State"
#   Last State: Terminated  Reason: Error  Exit Code: 1
kubectl logs api-x --previous                # o'lgan container log'i
kubectl logs api-x -c migrate --previous     # ko'p container bo'lsa
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
# Ilova darhol yiqilsa, ichini ko'rish uchun nusxa:
kubectl debug api-x -it --copy-to=api-debug --container=api -- sh
```
**Exit code'ni o'qish:**
| Kod | Ma'no |
|---|---|
| 1 | ilova xatosi (config, ulanish) — log'ga qarang |
| 127 | buyruq topilmadi (`command` noto'g'ri) |
| 137 | SIGKILL — ko'pincha OOMKilled yoki liveness |
| 143 | SIGTERM bilan to'xtatildi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Liveness probe noto'g'ri — ilova sog'lom, lekin kubelet o'ldiryapti. Events'da "Liveness probe failed" ni qidiring.
- Yo'q Secret/ConfigMap key — `CreateContainerConfigError` (bu boshqa holat).
- Ilova xato bilan emas, muvaffaqiyatli chiqib ketyapti (exit 0, foreground'da ishlamaydi) — Deployment'da bu ham CrashLoop.

**Senior nuqta:** CrashLoop'da ilova start'da aniq xato log'ini (qaysi env yo'q, qaysi hostga ulana olmadi) yozsin va tez yiqilsin (fail fast). Restart soni bo'yicha alert (`increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[15m]) > 3`) — muammoni foydalanuvchidan oldin ko'rsatadi.

33292.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ImagePullBackOff — kubelet image'ni yuklab ololmadi va qayta urinishni kechiktiryapti. Asosiy sabablar: noto'g'ri nom yoki tag, private registry uchun credential yo'q (`imagePullSecrets` / IAM), registry rate limit (Docker Hub), tarmoq/DNS/proxy muammosi, arxitektura mos emas (arm64 vs amd64).

**Amalda tekshirish:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | sed -n '/Events/,$p'
# Failed to pull image "ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.O": not found          -> tag xato
# ... 401 Unauthorized / denied: requested access                   -> credential
# ... 429 Too Many Requests                                         -> rate limit
# ... dial tcp: lookup ghcr.io: i/o timeout                         -> tarmoq/DNS
# ... no match for platform in manifest                             -> arxitektura
```
**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet -> containerd -> registry
   1. DNS + TLS ulanish
   2. auth (imagePullSecret yoki node IAM / credential provider)
   3. manifest (tag -> digest, platforma tanlash)
   4. layer'larni yuklash
Har bosqich xatosi Events'da alohida xabar beradi.
```

**Tuzatish:**
```bash
# Image mavjudmi?
crane manifest ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 | head
docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0   # platformalar ro'yxati
# Private registry credential
kubectl create secret docker-registry ghcr --docker-server=ghcr.io \
  --docker-username=bot --docker-password="$TOKEN" -n prod
kubectl patch sa default -n prod -p '{"imagePullSecrets":[{"name":"ghcr"}]}'
# Node'dan to'g'ridan sinash
crictl pull ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret boshqa namespace'da — imagePullSecret faqat o'z namespace'ida ishlaydi.
- EKS + ECR: node IAM rolida `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` va pull huquqlari yo'q.
- Docker Hub anonim limit — CI va cluster'ni pull-through cache/mirror orqali ishlating.
- Mac M-seriyada build qilingan image faqat arm64 — amd64 node'da ishlamaydi; `docker buildx --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64`.

**Senior nuqta:** Production'da tashqi public registry'ga bevosita bog'lanmang: ichki registry/pull-through cache (ECR, Harbor), image'lar digest bilan, va admission policy faqat ishonchli registry'larga ruxsat bersin — bu ham ishonchlilik, ham supply chain xavfsizligi.

33293.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kubectl exec` — ishlab turgan container ichida buyruq bajarish. `kubectl port-forward` — lokal portni pod/service portiga tunnel qilish (ingress'siz tekshirish). `kubectl debug` — ephemeral debug container qo'shish (distroless image'da shell bo'lmasa), pod nusxasini yaratish yoki node'ga kirish.

**Muammo:** zamonaviy image'lar distroless — ichida `sh`, `curl` yo'q, `exec` ishlamaydi. Debug uchun image'ni og'irlashtirmasdan vosita kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
exec:         kubectl -> apiserver -> kubelet -> container (mavjud process namespace)
port-forward: localhost:8080 -> apiserver -> kubelet -> pod:8080 (SPDY/WebSocket tunnel)
debug:        pod'ga ephemeral container (busybox/netshoot) qo'shiladi,
              --target bilan app container'ning process namespace'ini ko'radi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl exec -it api-x -c api -- sh
kubectl exec api-x -- env | sort
kubectl port-forward svc/api 8080:80 -n prod      # keyin: curl localhost:8080/healthz
kubectl port-forward pod/db-0 5432:5432
kubectl debug -it api-x --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=api -- bash
#   ps aux, ss -tlnp, dig db, curl -v http://localhost:8080
kubectl debug api-x -it --copy-to=api-dbg --set-image=api=busybox:1.36   # nusxada image almashtirish
kubectl debug node/worker-1 -it --image=ubuntu --profile=sysadmin        # node: /host da fayl tizimi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `exec` va `debug` huquqi = pod ichidagi Secret'lar, token'lar va ma'lumotga kirish. RBAC'da `pods/exec`, `pods/ephemeralcontainers`ni faqat kerakli odamlarga bering va audit log'da kuzating.
- Ephemeral container'ni o'chirib bo'lmaydi — pod qayta yaratilguncha qoladi.
- `port-forward` uzoq ishlatish uchun emas — ulanish uziladi, load balancing yo'q.
- Prod'da `exec` bilan fayl o'zgartirish — keyingi restart'da yo'qoladi va izi qolmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'ga `exec` — break-glass amaliyoti bo'lsin: vaqtinchalik huquq (JIT), audit va sabab yozilishi. Debug'ni asosan observability (log, metrika, trace) orqali qiling.

33294.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tartib bilan tekshiring: (1) DNS resolve bo'ladimi, (2) Service'ning endpoint'lari bormi (selector pod'larga mosmi, pod'lar Ready'mi), (3) port to'g'rimi (`port` vs `targetPort`), (4) NetworkPolicy bloklamayaptimi, (5) ilova to'g'ri interfeysda (`0.0.0.0`) tinglayaptimi.

**Muammo:** "ulanmayapti" — bu belgi, sabab emas. Har qatlamni alohida tekshirib, qaysi bo'g'inda uzilganini toping.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client pod
   | 1. DNS: api.prod -> ClusterIP           (CoreDNS)
   v
ClusterIP:80
   | 2. Service -> EndpointSlice (Ready pod IP'lar)
   v
pod IP:8080 (targetPort)
   | 3. NetworkPolicy ruxsat?
   v
ilova 0.0.0.0:8080 da tinglaydimi?
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl run net --rm -it -n prod --image=nicolaka/netshoot -- bash
  nslookup api                     # NXDOMAIN -> nom/namespace xato
  curl -sv http://api:80/healthz   # timeout -> endpoint/NetworkPolicy; refused -> port
  curl -sv http://10.0.3.15:8080/healthz   # pod IP'ga to'g'ridan
kubectl get svc api -o wide                       # selector, port, targetPort
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api   # bo'sh -> selector yoki readiness
kubectl get pods -l app=api --show-labels
kubectl get networkpolicy -n prod
kubectl exec api-x -- ss -tlnp      # 127.0.0.1:8080 bo'lsa tashqaridan kirib bo'lmaydi
kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns --tail=50
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Endpoint bo'sh — eng ko'p uchraydigan sabab: label typo yoki pod'lar readiness'dan o'tmagan.
- `targetPort` nomi (`http`) container port nomiga mos kelmaydi.
- Ilova `localhost`da tinglaydi — faqat pod ichidan ishlaydi.
- default-deny NetworkPolicy'da DNS (UDP/TCP 53) ga egress ruxsati unutilgan — hamma nom resolve bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cilium/Hubble kabi observability bilan `hubble observe --to-pod prod/api --verdict DROPPED` bir buyruqda qaysi policy paketni tashlaganini ko'rsatadi — taxmin o'rniga dalil.

33295.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ServiceAccount (SA) — pod'ning Kubernetes API (va workload identity orqali bulut) oldidagi identifikatori. Default holatda har pod namespace'ning `default` SA'si tokenini oladi. Ko'p ilovalar API bilan umuman gaplashmaydi — token kerak emas; u sizib chiqsa hujumchi shu huquqlar bilan API'ga kiradi. Shuning uchun `automountServiceAccountToken: false` va har ilovaga alohida minimal huquqli SA.

**Muammo (himoya nuqtai nazaridan):** ilovada RCE yoki SSRF zaifligi topilsa, `/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token` fayli hujumchiga cluster'ga kirish kalitini beradi. Agar `default` SA'ga kimdir keng rol bergan bo'lsa — butun namespace xavf ostida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod (sa: api) -> projected token (qisqa muddatli, audience bilan, ~1 soat, avtomatik yangilanadi)
   -> apiserver: token -> system:serviceaccount:prod:api -> RBAC tekshiruvi
1.24+: SA uchun uzoq yashaydigan Secret token avtomatik yaratilmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata: { name: api, namespace: prod }
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
spec:
  serviceAccountName: api
  automountServiceAccountToken: false     # API kerak bo'lmasa
```
```bash
kubectl auth can-i --list --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:default -n prod
kubectl get rolebindings,clusterrolebindings -A -o wide | grep -E "default|prod:"
kubectl create token api -n prod --duration=10m    # qisqa token (test uchun)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `default` SA'ga RoleBinding berish — namespace'dagi har pod shu huquqni oladi.
- Qo'lda `kubernetes.io/service-account-token` Secret yaratish — muddatsiz token; kerak bo'lmasa qilmang.
- Bulut huquqi uchun node IAM rolidan foydalanish — node'dagi barcha pod'lar bir xil huquq oladi; IRSA / EKS Pod Identity / GKE Workload Identity ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Identity har workload uchun alohida bo'lsin: SA = ilova, RBAC = minimal, bulut huquqi = workload identity. Policy (Kyverno) bilan `default` SA ishlatishni va token automount'ni default'da taqiqlang.

33296.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod Security Standards (PSS) — uchta tayyor profil: **privileged** (cheklovsiz, tizim komponentlari uchun), **baseline** (ma'lum xavfli narsalarni taqiqlaydi: privileged, hostNetwork/hostPID, hostPath, xavfli capability), **restricted** (qattiq: root emas, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, barcha capability drop, seccomp RuntimeDefault). Namespace label'lari orqali Pod Security Admission (PSA) qo'llaydi; PodSecurityPolicy 1.25 da olib tashlangan.

**Muammo (himoya):** container ichidagi root + privileged + hostPath = container'dan node'ga chiqish oson. Restricted profil zaiflik topilganda ham zararni container ichida ushlab qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
namespace label: pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted
pod yaratish -> PSA tekshiradi
   enforce: buzsa rad etadi
   audit:   audit log'ga yozadi
   warn:    kubectl'ga ogohlantirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl label ns prod \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version=latest \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted
kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns prod pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted
# -> mavjud qaysi pod'lar buzishini ko'rsatadi
```
```yaml
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10001
    fsGroup: 10001
    seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }
  containers:
  - name: api
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darhol `enforce` — mavjud workload'lar yangi pod yarata olmay qoladi. Avval `warn`/`audit`, keyin enforce.
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem` — ilova `/tmp`ga yozsa, emptyDir mount qiling.
- Image ichida USER root bo'lsa `runAsNonRoot` pod'ni ishga tushirmaydi — Dockerfile'da `USER 10001`.
- PSA faqat pod spec'ni tekshiradi; image tarkibi yoki registry'ni emas — buning uchun Kyverno/Gatekeeper.

**Senior nuqta:** Default — barcha ilova namespace'lari `restricted`, istisnolar (CNI, CSI, monitoring agent) alohida namespace'da `privileged` va hujjatlashtirilgan sabab bilan. Nozik qoidalar (registry, label, resource) uchun PSA + policy engine birga.

33297.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Least privilege RBAC: har ilova/odam uchun alohida identity, imkon qadar **Role + RoleBinding** (namespace darajasida), aniq `verbs` va `resources`, `*` yo'q, `cluster-admin` faqat break-glass. Tekshirish: `kubectl auth can-i`, `--as` bilan impersonation, `rbac-tool`/`kubectl who-can` va audit log.

**Muammo (himoya):** CI ServiceAccount'iga "qulaylik uchun" cluster-admin berilgan. CI token sizib chiqsa — butun cluster, barcha Secret'lar bilan, hujumchiga ochiq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Subject (User/Group/SA) --RoleBinding--> Role (namespace) : verbs x resources
                        --ClusterRoleBinding--> ClusterRole (butun cluster)
RBAC faqat ruxsat beradi (deny yo'q): huquqlar yig'indisi.
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: prod }
rules:
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","patch","update"]
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata: { name: ci-deployer, namespace: prod }
subjects: [{ kind: ServiceAccount, name: ci, namespace: ci }]
roleRef: { kind: Role, name: deployer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }
```
```bash
kubectl auth can-i delete secrets -n prod --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:ci   # no
kubectl auth can-i --list -n prod --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:ci
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.roleRef.name=="cluster-admin") | .subjects'
```

**Tuzoqlar (yashirin keng huquqlar):**
- `secrets` `list`/`watch` — barcha Secret qiymatlarini o'qish degani.
- `pods/exec`, `create pods` — pod yaratib istalgan SA bilan ishlatish orqali huquq oshirish.
- `escalate`, `bind`, `impersonate` verb'lari va RBAC obyektlarini tahrirlash — o'zi admin bo'lish yo'li.
- `nodes/proxy` — kubelet API orqali har pod'ga exec.

**Senior nuqta:** Odamlar uchun SSO guruhlari (OIDC) + guruhga bog'langan rollar, shaxsiy statik credential yo'q. RBAC'ni Git'da saqlang, PR review qiling va davriy audit (kim cluster-admin, kim secrets o'qiy oladi) avtomatlashtiring.

33298.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval namespace'ga **default-deny** (ingress va egress) NetworkPolicy qo'yasiz, keyin faqat kerakli oqimlarni aniq ruxsat berasiz: DNS'ga egress, frontend -> api, api -> db va hokazo. NetworkPolicy faqat CNI qo'llasa ishlaydi (Calico, Cilium; oddiy flannel — yo'q).

**Muammo (himoya):** default holatda har pod har pod bilan gaplasha oladi. Bitta zaif frontend pod buzilsa, hujumchi to'g'ridan DB'ga yoki boshqa jamoaning servislariga ulanadi (lateral movement).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
default-deny: podSelector {} + policyTypes [Ingress, Egress], qoidalar yo'q
   -> hamma narsa yopiq
allow qoidalari qo'shiladi (yig'indisi ruxsat):
   web --8080--> api --5432--> db
   hamma -> kube-dns:53
NetworkPolicy additive: deny qoidasi yo'q, faqat "tanlangan pod'lar uchun ruxsat ro'yxati"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: { matchLabels: { kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system } }
      podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } }
    ports: [{ port: 53, protocol: UDP }, { port: 53, protocol: TCP }]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: api-to-db, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: db } }
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
  - from: [{ podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } } }]
    ports: [{ port: 5432 }]
```
```bash
kubectl get netpol -n prod
kubectl run t --rm -it -n prod --labels=app=web --image=nicolaka/netshoot -- nc -zv db 5432   # bloklanishi kerak
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DNS egress'ni unutish — hamma ilova "ishlamay qoldi".
- `from` ichida `namespaceSelector` va `podSelector` bitta element (AND) yoki ikki element (OR) — bitta tire farqi butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.
- Ingress controller, monitoring (Prometheus scrape) uchun ruxsat unutiladi.
- L7 (HTTP path) filtrlash standart NetworkPolicy'da yo'q — Cilium/mesh kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Default-deny'ni bosqichma-bosqich joriy qiling: avval Hubble/flow log bilan haqiqiy oqimlarni yozib oling, keyin policy yarating va audit rejimida sinang. Policy'lar ilova chart'ining bir qismi bo'lsin — ilova egasi o'z oqimlarini biladi.

33299.a:
**Qisqa javob:** K8s Secret'lar default'da faqat base64 (shifrlanmagan) — ularni Git'da ochiq saqlab bo'lmaydi. Uch yondashuv: **External Secrets Operator** (haqiqiy qiymat Vault/AWS Secrets Manager/GCP SM'da, operator K8s Secret'ga sinxronlaydi), **Sealed Secrets** (cluster kaliti bilan shifrlangan SealedSecret Git'da, controller ochadi), **SOPS** (fayl ichidagi qiymatlar KMS/age bilan shifrlanadi, Flux/Argo plugin ochadi). Qo'shimcha: etcd encryption at rest, RBAC, rotatsiya.

**Muammo (himoya):** `secret.yaml` Git'ga commit qilindi — repo'ga kirishi bor har kim (va har fork, CI log) parolni ko'radi; Git tarixidan o'chirish deyarli imkonsiz, faqat rotatsiya.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ESO:     Vault/ASM (manba) <--IAM/WI-- ESO --> K8s Secret --> pod
Sealed:  kubeseal (public key) -> SealedSecret (Git) -> controller (private key) -> Secret
SOPS:    sops -e (KMS) -> secret.enc.yaml (Git) -> Flux decrypt -> Secret
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata: { name: db-creds, namespace: prod }
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef: { name: aws-sm, kind: ClusterSecretStore }
  target: { name: db-creds }
  data:
  - secretKey: password
    remoteRef: { key: prod/db, property: password }
```
```bash
kubeseal --format yaml < secret.yaml > sealed.yaml        # Sealed Secrets
sops --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc --encrypted-regex '^(data|stringData)$' secret.yaml > secret.enc.yaml
kubectl get externalsecret -n prod                        # STATUS SecretSynced
```

| | ESO | Sealed Secrets | SOPS |
|---|---|---|---|
| Haqiqat manbai | tashqi vault | Git | Git |
| Rotatsiya | markaziy, oson | qayta seal | qayta shifrlash |
| Bog'liqlik | vault + IAM | controller kaliti | KMS/age |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sealed Secrets private key'ini zaxiralamaslik — cluster qayta qurilsa barcha secret'lar ochilmaydi.
- Secret'ni env sifatida berish — crash dump, `/proc`, log'larda ko'rinishi mumkin; fayl mount afzal.
- `get/list secrets` RBAC huquqi keng berilsa barcha yondashuvlar foydasiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: bulut resurslari uchun workload identity (IRSA, Workload Identity), DB uchun IAM auth yoki Vault dynamic credentials (qisqa muddatli). Statik secret qolsa — markaziy vault, avtomatik rotatsiya va audit.

33300.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OOMKilled — container cgroup memory limitidan oshdi va kernel uni SIGKILL bilan o'ldirdi (exit code 137). Tahlil: `describe` da `Reason: OOMKilled` tasdiqlash -> memory grafigi (sekin o'sish = leak, keskin pik = yuk/katta so'rov) -> ilova runtime sozlamasi limitga mosmi (JVM heap, GOMEMLIMIT, Node.js `--max-old-space-size`) -> limit yoki kodni tuzatish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
limits.memory: 512Mi  -> cgroup memory.max = 512Mi
ilova RSS + page cache (qisman) -> 512Mi ga yetdi
kernel OOM killer (cgroup ichida) -> SIGKILL -> exit 137
kubelet -> restart (CrashLoopBackOff bo'lishi mumkin)
Node darajasidagi OOM (limitsiz pod'lar) — boshqa hodisa: istalgan jarayon o'ldirilishi mumkin.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A5 "Last State"
#   Reason: OOMKilled  Exit Code: 137
kubectl top pod api-x --containers
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources}'
# node'da kernel log
```
