```bash
kubectl debug node/worker-1 -it --image=ubuntu -- chroot /host dmesg -T | grep -i "killed process"
```
```promql
container_memory_working_set_bytes{pod=~"api.*",container="api"}
/ on(pod,container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}
```
Grafik o'qish: arra tishli o'sish va restart -> leak; trafik pikiga mos sakrash -> yuk; start'da darhol -> limit juda past.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- JVM: `-Xmx` limitga teng — heap'dan tashqari (metaspace, thread stack, direct buffer) joy qolmaydi. `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75` ishlating.
- Go: `GOMEMLIMIT` qo'yilmasa GC limitni bilmaydi.
- Faqat limitni oshirish — leak bo'lsa keyinroq baribir o'ladi va node'larni ko'proq band qiladi.
- `kubectl top` working set ko'rsatadi; OOM ham working set'ga qarab — RSS bilan adashtirmang.

**Senior nuqta:** Leak shubhasi bo'lsa — profil (Go `pprof` heap, JVM heap dump OOM'da: `-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError` PVC'ga) oling. Alert: memory/limit > 90% 10 daqiqa — OOM'dan oldin ogohlantiradi.

33301.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 502/503 — yo'lning qaysi bo'g'inida xato tug'ilganini aniqlang: tashqi LB -> ingress controller -> Service/endpoint -> pod. **503** odatda "backend yo'q" (endpoint bo'sh, pod'lar Ready emas, LB health check o'tmagan). **502** — backend bilan ulanish buzildi (pod o'ldi/restart, noto'g'ri port/protokol, keep-alive timeout nomuvofiqligi, graceful shutdown yo'q).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client -> Cloud LB (target health) -> ingress-nginx pod -> Service -> pod:8080
   503: LB'da sog'lom target yo'q   | nginx: upstream'da endpoint yo'q
   502: nginx pod'ga ulandi, lekin javob buzildi/uzildi (reset, noto'g'ri protokol)
   504: pod javobi timeout'dan uzun
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -sv https://shop.example.com/api/health      # javob kimdan? Server header, body
kubectl logs -n ingress-nginx deploy/ingress-nginx-controller --tail=200 | grep -E " 50[234] "
#  upstream: "http://10.0.3.15:8080" ... upstream prematurely closed connection
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api
kubectl get pods -l app=api            # Ready? RESTARTS?
kubectl describe ingress shop          # backend service/port to'g'rimi
kubectl port-forward svc/api 8080:80 && curl localhost:8080/health   # ingress'ni chetlab
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn ...                # LB target holati
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat deploy paytida 502 — graceful shutdown/preStop yo'q (eski pod o'ldi, nginx hali yuboryapti).
- Backend HTTPS kutadi, ingress HTTP yuboryapti (yoki aksincha) — `backend-protocol` annotation.
- Ilovaning keep-alive timeout'i ingress/LB'nikidan qisqa — ulanish ishlatilayotganda yopiladi, tasodifiy 502.
- LB health check yo'li ilovada yo'q (404) — barcha target unhealthy, 503.

**Senior nuqta:** Har qatlamda access log + upstream status/latency maydonlari bo'lsin (nginx `$upstream_status`, `$upstream_response_time`). Shunda "502 kim qaytardi" savoliga log'ning o'zi javob beradi; SLO'ni esa foydalanuvchiga eng yaqin qatlamda (LB) o'lchang.

33302.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Supply chain xavfsizligi = cluster'da faqat **siz qurgan, tekshirilgan va o'zgartirilmagan** image ishlashini isbotlash. Qatlamlar: (1) CI'da image va bog'liqliklarni skanerlash (Trivy, Grype) + SBOM, (2) image'ni imzolash (cosign, keyless Sigstore) va provenance attestation (SLSA), (3) admission policy (Kyverno/Sigstore policy-controller) faqat imzolangan, digest bilan ko'rsatilgan, ishonchli registry'dagi image'larga ruxsat beradi.

**Muammo (himoya):** hujumchi registry credential'ini o'g'irlab `api:1.5.0` tagini zararli image bilan almashtirdi; yoki bog'liqlik (npm/PyPI) paketiga zararli kod kiritildi. Skanersiz va imzosiz siz buni deploy qilasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
commit -> CI (izolyatsiyalangan runner)
   build -> SBOM (syft) -> scan (trivy, CRITICAL bo'lsa fail)
   push -> digest sha256:...
   cosign sign (OIDC identity: repo + workflow) + attest (SBOM, provenance)
cluster: pod yaratish -> Kyverno verifyImages:
   imzo to'g'ri? identity = github.com/acme/api workflow? digest? -> ruxsat / rad
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
syft ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 -o spdx-json > sbom.json
cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c...
cosign attest --yes --predicate sbom.json --type spdxjson ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c...
cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c... \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/acme/api/.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: verify-images }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  rules:
  - name: signed
    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }
    verifyImages:
    - imageReferences: ["ghcr.io/acme/*"]
      mutateDigest: true
      attestors:
      - entries:
        - keyless:
            subject: "https://github.com/acme/*"
            issuer: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat skanerlash — deploy paytidagi image boshqa bo'lishi mumkin; imzo + digest kerak.
- Skaner natijalari "har deploy fail" bo'lsa jamoalar uni o'chiradi — fix mavjud bo'lgan CRITICAL'larga fokus, istisno jarayoni bilan.
- Base image'lar ham bog'liqlik — minimal (distroless, Chainguard/Wolfi) va muntazam yangilanadigan tanlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — tekshiriladigan zanjir: "bu pod'dagi image aynan shu commit'dan, shu CI'da qurilgan" degan dalil. Bu incident paytida ham qimmatli: zaif kutubxona e'lon qilinsa, SBOM orqali qaysi servislar ta'sirlanganini daqiqalarda topasiz.

33303.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bir cluster'da ko'p jamoa uchun qatlamli izolyatsiya: **namespace** (chegara) + **RBAC** (faqat o'z namespace'i) + **ResourceQuota/LimitRange** (resurs adolati) + **NetworkPolicy default-deny** (tarmoq) + **Pod Security restricted** (node'ga chiqish yo'q) + **policy engine** (registry, label, ingress host qoidalari). Qattiqroq izolyatsiya: alohida node pool (taint), vcluster, yoki alohida cluster.

**Muammo (himoya):** A jamoasining pod'i B jamoasining DB'siga ulanadi, yoki A ning xato deploy'i butun cluster resursini yeydi, yoki A dasturchisi privileged pod orqali node'ga chiqib, B ning Secret'larini o'qiydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
             yumshoq (soft) <----------------------------> qattiq (hard)
namespace+RBAC+quota+netpol | +alohida node pool | vcluster | alohida cluster
   arzon, bitta kernel       |  kernel ajratilgan |  API ajratilgan | to'liq
```

**Amalda (namespace "shablon"i):**
```bash
kubectl create ns team-a
kubectl label ns team-a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted team=a
kubectl apply -n team-a -f quota.yaml -f limitrange.yaml -f default-deny.yaml
kubectl create rolebinding team-a-edit --clusterrole=edit --group=team-a -n team-a
kubectl auth can-i get secrets -n team-b --as=alice --as-group=team-a   # no
```
Kyverno `generate` qoidasi har yangi namespace'ga shu resurslarni avtomatik qo'yishi mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cluster-scope resurslar (CRD, ClusterRole, IngressClass, StorageClass) namespace bilan izolyatsiya qilinmaydi.
- Ingress host to'qnashuvi: A jamoasi B ning domenini "o'g'irlashi" mumkin — policy bilan host'larni namespace'ga bog'lang.
- `edit` ClusterRole Secret'larni o'qishga ruxsat beradi — kerak bo'lsa o'z rolingizni yarating.
- Shared kernel: container escape zaifligi barcha tenant'larga ta'sir qiladi — ishonchsiz kod (tashqi mijoz kodi) uchun gVisor/Kata yoki alohida cluster.

**Senior nuqta:** Izolyatsiya darajasini ishonch darajasiga qarab tanlang: bir kompaniya ichidagi jamoalar — soft multi-tenancy yetarli; tashqi mijozlar yoki tartibga solinadigan ma'lumot — hard. Platformani "self-service namespace" sifatida qiling: jamoa so'raydi, guardrail'lar avtomatik keladi.

33304.a:
Tartib:
1. **Nima o'zgardi?** deploy/upgrade/config (`kubectl get events -A`, GitOps tarixi).
2. **Node'lar:** `kubectl get nodes`, `top nodes`, NotReady, pressure, CPU steal.
3. **DNS:** CoreDNS latency/xatolar — klassik "hamma narsa sekin" sababi (ndots:5 + tashqi domen -> 5 ta keraksiz so'rov). NodeLocal DNSCache.
4. **Tarmoq:** conntrack to'lishi (`nf_conntrack: table full`), CNI IP tugashi.
5. **Umumiy dependency:** DB connections, Redis latency.
6. **Throttling:** CPU limit throttling hamma pod'larda.
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
Containment: trafik kamaytirish/rate limit, oxirgi o'zgarishni rollback — root cause'ni keyin.

33305.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Velero — K8s resurslari (YAML obyektlar) va PV ma'lumotlarini (CSI snapshot yoki fayl darajasida Kopia orqali) object storage'ga zaxiralaydi va tiklaydi. DR strategiyasi: RPO/RTO maqsadlarini belgilash, nimani qayerdan tiklash (GitOps — manifestlar, Velero — holat va PV, managed DB — o'z backup'i), boshqa region/hisobga nusxa va **muntazam tiklash mashqi**.

**Muammo:** cluster butunlay yo'qoldi (region outage, xato `terraform destroy`, ransomware). "Backup bor" — lekin hech kim tiklab ko'rmagan, PV snapshot'lar o'sha region'da edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Velero server (cluster ichida)
   backup: API'dan resurslar -> tar -> S3 (boshqa region/hisob)
           PV -> CSI VolumeSnapshot yoki Kopia fayl backup -> S3
   restore: yangi cluster -> Velero o'rnatish -> S3'dan o'qish -> resurslar + PV
Ideal DR qatlamlari:
   infra: Terraform          | manifestlar: Git + Argo CD
   holat: Velero / DB backup | sirlar: tashqi secret manager
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
velero install --provider aws --bucket k8s-dr --backup-location-config region=eu-central-1 \
  --features=EnableCSI --use-node-agent
velero schedule create daily --schedule="0 2 * * *" --ttl 720h \
  --include-namespaces prod --snapshot-move-data
velero backup get
velero backup describe daily-20261003020000 --details
velero restore create --from-backup daily-20261003020000 --namespace-mappings prod:prod-restore
velero restore describe <name>     # warnings/errors
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Snapshot'lar default'da manba region'da — region yo'qolsa ular ham yo'q. `--snapshot-move-data` yoki cross-region nusxa.
- Backup bucket'i o'sha hisobda va yozish huquqi bilan — ransomware uni ham o'chiradi. Object Lock (immutable) + alohida hisob.
- Crash-consistent snapshot DB uchun yetarli bo'lmasligi mumkin — DB'ning o'z backup'i (pg_dump/WAL) yoki pre-backup hook (fsfreeze).
- Velero backup'ida Secret'lar bor — bucket shifrlansin, kirish cheklansin.

**Senior nuqta:** DR — hujjat emas, mashq: chorakda bir marta bo'sh cluster'ga to'liq tiklab, haqiqiy RTO'ni o'lchang. Ko'p hollarda eng tez DR — "cattle" yondashuv: Terraform + GitOps bilan yangi cluster 30 daqiqada, faqat holat (DB, PV) backup'dan.

33306.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kubeconfig (`~/.kube/config`) — cluster'lar, user (credential)lar va ularni bog'lovchi **context**'lar ro'yxati. Context = cluster + user + default namespace. `kubectl config use-context` bilan almashtiriladi, namespace `-n` yoki context'ga yozib qo'yiladi.

**Muammo:** dev, stage, prod cluster'lari bitta noutbukda. Noto'g'ri context'da `kubectl delete` — eng ko'p uchraydigan incident sababi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
clusters:  [dev-eks, prod-eks]        (server URL + CA)
users:     [dev-sso, prod-sso]        (token / exec plugin)
contexts:  dev  = dev-eks  + dev-sso  + ns=team-a
           prod = prod-eks + prod-sso + ns=default
current-context: dev
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl config get-contexts             # * hozirgisi
kubectl config current-context
kubectl config use-context prod
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=payments
KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/dev:~/.kube/prod kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/config
aws eks update-kubeconfig --name prod --alias prod   # EKS
# tezkor: kubectx / kubens (krew)
kubectx prod && kubens payments
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prod context default bo'lib qolishi. Yechim: prompt'da context ko'rsatish (kube-ps1, starship), prod uchun alohida terminal/rang.
- kubeconfig'da statik token yoki client sertifikat — sizib chiqsa uzoq yashaydigan kalit. Zamonaviy usul — `exec` plugin (aws, gke-gcloud-auth-plugin, kubelogin) qisqa muddatli token bilan.
- `chmod 600 ~/.kube/config` — boshqa userlar o'qimasin.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'ga yozish huquqi odamlarda minimal bo'lsin: o'zgarish GitOps orqali, odam faqat read-only yoki vaqtinchalik (just-in-time) break-glass rolini oladi.

33307.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Imperative** — "buni qil" buyruqlari (`kubectl create`, `run`, `scale`, `set image`): tez, lekin izi qolmaydi. **Declarative** — "shunday bo'lsin" (`kubectl apply -f`): holat faylda, Git'da, takrorlanadi va review qilinadi.

**Muammo:** kimdir prod'da `kubectl scale --replicas=10` qildi, keyin boshqasi eski YAML'ni apply qildi — 3 ga qaytdi. Kim, nega, qachon — noma'lum.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Imperative:  odam --buyruq--> apiserver   (holat faqat cluster'da)
Declarative: Git (YAML) --apply/GitOps--> apiserver
             apply = diff(last-applied, fayl, live) -> patch
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Imperative — o'rganish, debug, tez sinov
kubectl run tmp --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh
kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx:1.27

# Imperative'dan YAML skeleti olish (eng foydali usul)
kubectl create deployment api --image=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml > deploy.yaml

# Declarative
kubectl diff -f deploy.yaml
kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8s/ --prune -l app=api   # ehtiyot bilan
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `kubectl create -f` (imperative object config) va `apply -f` ni aralashtirish — `last-applied-configuration` annotation yo'q bo'lib, keyingi apply ogohlantirish beradi.
- `kubectl edit` prod'da — drift: Git va cluster farq qiladi.
- `--prune` noto'g'ri label bilan kerakli resurslarni o'chirib yuborishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: imperative — faqat o'qish va favqulodda holat; har qanday favqulodda o'zgarishdan keyin Git'ga ham yoziladi. GitOps controller drift'ni o'zi qaytaradi — bu imperative o'zgarishlarni "yo'qotadi", shuning uchun jamoa buni bilishi kerak.

33308.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Label** — tanlash (select) uchun qisqa key/value: Service, Deployment selector, `kubectl get -l` ular bo'yicha ishlaydi. **Annotation** — tanlanmaydigan metadata: tool'lar uchun konfiguratsiya, izoh, katta matn (Ingress sozlamalari, change-cause, Prometheus scrape).

**Nega farqlanadi:** label'lar indekslanadi va filtrlashda ishlatiladi, shuning uchun qat'iy cheklangan (qiymat <= 63 belgi). Annotation'ga esa JSON ham sig'adi (jami 256KB gacha), lekin u bo'yicha selector qila olmaysiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Service selector app=api  ----tanlaydi---->  Pod labels {app: api, tier: backend}
Ingress controller        ----o'qiydi----->  annotations {nginx.ingress.../proxy-body-size: 20m}
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.5.0"
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: shop
    team: payments
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "v1.5.0: yangi checkout"
    prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
```
```bash
kubectl get pods -l 'app.kubernetes.io/name=api,team in (payments)'
kubectl label pod api-x debug=true
kubectl label pod api-x debug-             # olib tashlash
kubectl annotate deploy api owner=team-payments
kubectl get pods -L team                   # label'ni ustun qilib ko'rsatish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Service selector'idagi label'ni pod'dan olib tashlasangiz — pod trafikdan chiqadi (debug uchun foydali hiyla ham).
- Label qiymatiga commit SHA yoki tez o'zgaruvchi narsa yozish — Deployment selector'ga tushsa, immutable bo'lib qoladi.
- Annotation'ga secret yozish — hamma ko'radi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tavsiya etilgan `app.kubernetes.io/*` label'larini standart qiling: monitoring, cost allocation (Kubecost), NetworkPolicy va policy engine'lar (Kyverno) shu label'larga tayanadi.

33309.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `-o wide` — qo'shimcha ustunlar (node, IP), `-o yaml` — to'liq obyekt (spec + status), `-w` — o'zgarishlarni jonli kuzatish, `kubectl explain` — maydon hujjati to'g'ridan cluster schema'sidan.

**Nega kerak:** oddiy `kubectl get` faqat yuzaki holatni beradi. "Pod qaysi node'da?", "nega Pending?", "bu maydon nima degani?" — chuqurroq ko'rish kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pods -o wide                  # IP, NODE, NOMINATED NODE
kubectl get pod api-x -o yaml | less      # status.conditions, containerStatuses
kubectl get pods -w                       # Ctrl+C gacha o'zgarishlar
kubectl get pods --show-labels
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.nodeName}'
kubectl get pods -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount
kubectl get pods --sort-by=.status.startTime
kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running -A
kubectl explain deployment.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate
kubectl explain pod.spec.containers --recursive | less
kubectl api-resources                     # qisqa nomlar (deploy, svc, cm)
```
**O'qish:** `-o yaml` da avval `status.conditions` (Ready/False va `reason`), keyin `containerStatuses[].state` / `lastState` (`terminated.reason: OOMKilled`, `exitCode`) ga qarang.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `-o yaml` natijasini to'g'ridan qayta apply qilish — `status`, `resourceVersion`, `uid` kabi maydonlar aralashadi.
- `-w` faqat yangi event'larni ko'rsatadi; ulanish uzilsa qayta ishga tushirish kerak.
- `explain` cluster versiyasiga bog'liq — internetdagi hujjat boshqa versiya bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Skript va alert'larda chiroyli chiqish emas, `jsonpath`/`-o json | jq` ishlating; `kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod -l app=api --timeout=120s` sleep'li sikllardan ancha ishonchli.

33310.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5` — darhol ishlaydi. Lekin GitOps (Argo CD/Flux) yoki HPA bo'lsa, qo'lda qiymat tez orada qaytarib yoziladi: Git'dagi `replicas` yoki HPA hisobi g'olib chiqadi.

**Muammo:** tunda trafik oshdi, on-call qo'lda 10 ga ko'tardi. 3 daqiqadan keyin Argo CD "OutOfSync" deb 3 ga qaytardi — incident kuchaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
odam: replicas=10 --> apiserver
                         ^
Argo CD (selfHeal) ------+  Git: replicas=3 -> qaytaradi
HPA -------------------- +  metrika: kerakli=6 -> o'zgartiradi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5
kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5 --current-replicas=3   # optimistik shart
kubectl get hpa api                                          # HPA bormi?
```
HPA ishlatilsa, Git'da `replicas` maydonini **olib tashlang**, aks holda har sync HPA bilan urushadi:
```yaml
# Argo CD Application
spec:
  ignoreDifferences:
  - group: apps
    kind: Deployment
    jsonPointers: [/spec/replicas]
```
Favqulodda holat: HPA'ning `minReplicas`'ini Git orqali (yoki tez PR) ko'taring.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HPA + Git'dagi `replicas` — har deploy replikani 3 ga "sakratib" tushiradi.
- Argo CD'da `selfHeal` o'chiq bo'lsa ham keyingi sync qaytaradi.
- Scale 0 — pod'lar o'chadi, lekin PVC'lar qoladi (StatefulSet).

**Senior nuqta:** Replika sonining "egasi" bitta bo'lsin: yo Git, yo HPA. Incident runbook'da "qo'lda scale qilinsa Argo'da auto-sync'ni vaqtincha o'chir va keyin Git'ga yoz" qadamini aniq yozing.

33311.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Service DNS: `<service>.<namespace>.svc.<cluster-domain>` (odatda `cluster.local`). Masalan `db.prod.svc.cluster.local`. Bir namespace ichida faqat `db` yetarli. Headless Service'da har pod: `<pod>.<service>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local`.

**Nega kerak:** pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi. Service barqaror nom va virtual IP (ClusterIP) beradi, CoreDNS esa nomni IP'ga aylantiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app pod: "db" ni resolve qil
   | /etc/resolv.conf: search prod.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
   v
CoreDNS --> db.prod.svc.cluster.local -> 10.96.12.7 (ClusterIP)
   |
kube-proxy/eBPF: 10.96.12.7 -> pod IP'lardan biri
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl run dns --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh
nslookup db                          # shu namespace
nslookup db.prod                     # boshqa namespace
nslookup db.prod.svc.cluster.local   # to'liq nom (FQDN)
cat /etc/resolv.conf                 # search domain'lar, ndots:5
# headless (clusterIP: None) — pod IP'lar ro'yxati qaytadi
nslookup postgres-headless.prod.svc.cluster.local
# SRV record: port nomi bilan
nslookup -type=SRV _http._tcp.api.prod.svc.cluster.local
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Boshqa namespace'dagi servisga faqat `db` deb murojaat qilish — `NXDOMAIN`.
- `ndots:5` sababli `api.example.com` kabi tashqi nomlar avval search domain'lar bilan sinab ko'riladi — keraksiz DNS so'rovlar. Tashqi nom oxiriga nuqta qo'ying yoki `ndots`ni kamaytiring.
- `ExternalName` Service — faqat CNAME, port xaritalashi yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta cluster'da DNS — yashirin bottleneck: NodeLocal DNSCache yoqing va CoreDNS metrikalari (`coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds`)ni kuzating.

33312.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ConfigMap'ni ikki usulda berasiz: **env** (`env.valueFrom.configMapKeyRef` yoki `envFrom`) — pod start'da bir marta o'qiladi; **volume** — har key fayl bo'ladi va ConfigMap o'zgarsa fayl ~1 daqiqada avtomatik yangilanadi (subPath'dan tashqari).

**Nega kerak:** konfiguratsiyani image'ga qotirmaslik — bitta image dev va prod'da turli sozlama bilan ishlaydi (12-factor).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ConfigMap api-config
  |-- env:    LOG_LEVEL=info   (start'da muzlaydi)
  +-- volume: /etc/app/app.yaml (kubelet sync bilan yangilanadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: { name: api-config }
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  app.yaml: |
    timeout: 5s
---
spec:
  containers:
  - name: api
    env:
    - name: LOG_LEVEL
      valueFrom: { configMapKeyRef: { name: api-config, key: LOG_LEVEL } }
    envFrom:
    - configMapRef: { name: api-config }
    volumeMounts:
    - { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/app, readOnly: true }
  volumes:
  - name: cfg
    configMap:
      name: api-config
      items: [{ key: app.yaml, path: app.yaml }]
```
```bash
kubectl create configmap api-config --from-file=app.yaml --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml > cm.yaml
kubectl exec deploy/api -- cat /etc/app/app.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/api     # env o'zgarishini qo'llash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Env o'zgarishi pod restart'siz qo'llanmaydi.
- `subPath` bilan mount qilingan fayl hech qachon yangilanmaydi.
- Fayl yangilansa ham ilova uni qayta o'qimasa foydasi yo'q (reload signal yoki watcher kerak).
- Maxfiy ma'lumotni ConfigMap'ga yozish — Secret ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** "Yashirin" config o'zgarishlaridan qochish uchun immutable ConfigMap + nomga hash (Kustomize `configMapGenerator`, Helm `checksum/config` annotation) ishlating: o'zgarish = yangi rollout = rollback qilinadigan revision.

33313.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod phase'lari: **Pending** (qabul qilindi, lekin hali joylanmagan yoki image yuklanmoqda), **Running** (kamida bitta container ishlayapti), **Succeeded** (hammasi 0 kod bilan tugadi), **Failed** (kamida bittasi xato bilan tugadi), **Unknown** (node bilan aloqa yo'q). `ContainerCreating`, `CrashLoopBackOff`, `Terminating` — bu phase emas, `kubectl` ko'rsatadigan container holati/sabab.

**Nega bilish kerak:** debug har doim "pod qaysi bosqichda qotdi?" savolidan boshlanadi — har bosqichning sababi va tekshiruvi boshqa.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
create -> Pending --(scheduler node tanladi)--> ContainerCreating
            |                                      | image pull, volume mount
            | (joy yo'q: Unschedulable)            v
                                                Running --(Ready probe)--> trafik
                                                   |
                    restartPolicy=Never/OnFailure  v
                                       Succeeded / Failed
delete -> Terminating (preStop + SIGTERM + grace) -> yo'qoladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pod api-x                     # STATUS ustuni
kubectl describe pod api-x                # Events: FailedScheduling, Pulling, BackOff
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'   # PodScheduled, Initialized, ContainersReady, Ready
```
| Ko'rinish | Odatiy sabab |
|---|---|
| Pending uzoq | resurs yo'q, taint, PVC bog'lanmagan |
| ContainerCreating uzoq | image katta, volume attach, CNI xato |
| Terminating qotgan | finalizer, node yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Running` != tayyor. `READY 0/1` bo'lsa readiness o'tmagan, trafik yo'q.
- Terminating'da qotgan pod'ni `--force --grace-period=0` bilan o'chirish StatefulSet'da ikki nusxa xavfini tug'diradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Monitoring'da phase emas, `kube_pod_status_ready` va restart soni (`kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total`) bo'yicha alert qiling — Running lekin Ready emas pod'lar eng yashirin muammo.

33314.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **DEBUG** — dasturchi uchun batafsil ichki holat (prod'da odatda o'chiq). **INFO** — normal muhim hodisalar (servis start, buyurtma yaratildi). **WARN** — g'ayrioddiy, lekin tizim o'zini tikladi (retry muvaffaqiyatli, deprecated API ishlatildi). **ERROR** — operatsiya muvaffaqiyatsiz, kimdir e'tibor berishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin. (FATAL — jarayon to'xtaydi.)

**Muammo:** hamma narsa ERROR — on-call 10 000 "xato" ichidan haqiqiysini topa olmaydi. Hamma narsa DEBUG — log hajmi va narxi portlaydi, sekundiga megabaytlar.

**Qanday tanlash:**
```
Bu hodisa uchun kimdir uyg'onishi kerakmi?          -> ERROR (va alert metrikada)
Tizim o'zi hal qildi, lekin trend kuzatilsin?        -> WARN
Biznes jarayoni normal o'tdi, audit/kontekst uchun? -> INFO
Faqat debug paytida kerak?                           -> DEBUG
```

**Amalda:**
```go
logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelInfo}))
logger.Info("order created", "order_id", id, "amount", amt)
logger.Warn("payment retry", "attempt", 2, "err", err)
logger.Error("payment failed", "order_id", id, "err", err)
logger.Debug("cache lookup", "key", k)   // prod'da chiqmaydi
```
```bash
LOG_LEVEL=debug ./app                                  # vaqtincha batafsil
kubectl logs deploy/api | jq 'select(.level=="ERROR")'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Klient xatosi (404, validatsiya) ni ERROR qilish — bu sizning xatongiz emas; INFO/WARN.
- Bir xatoni har qatlamda qayta log qilish — bitta muammo 5 ta ERROR bo'ladi. Xatoni bir joyda (chegarada) log qiling, ichkarida kontekst bilan qaytaring.
- Level'ni o'zgartirish uchun deploy kerak — runtime'da (env, signal, admin endpoint) o'zgartirish imkoni bo'lsin.

**Senior nuqta:** Alert'lar log level'iga emas, metrikalarga (error rate, SLO) asoslansin. Log — "nima bo'ldi"ni tushuntirish uchun, metrika — "muammo bormi"ni aniqlash uchun.

33315.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Strukturaviy log — har yozuv matn emas, maydonlarga ega obyekt (odatda JSON): `{"ts":..., "level":"error", "msg":"payment failed", "order_id":"o-42", "trace_id":"..."}`. Afzalligi: mashina aniq filtrlaydi, agregatsiya qiladi va maydon bo'yicha qidiradi — regex bilan taxmin qilish shart emas.

**Muammo:** `Payment failed for order 42 after 3 tries` — "3 dan ortiq urinishli xatolar soni"ni topish uchun murakkab regex kerak, format o'zgarsa buziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Matn:    2026-10-03 10:00:01 ERROR Payment failed for order 42 after 3 tries
JSON:    {"ts":"2026-10-03T10:00:01Z","level":"error","msg":"payment failed",
          "order_id":"42","attempts":3,"trace_id":"4bf9..."}
             |
             v
Loki/Elastic: level="error" AND attempts>=3 | count by order_id
```

**Amalda:**
```go
slog.Error("payment failed", "order_id", id, "attempts", n, "trace_id", tid, "err", err)
```
```bash
kubectl logs deploy/api | jq -c 'select(.level=="error") | {ts, order_id, err}'
```
```logql
{app="api"} | json | level="error" and attempts >= 3
sum by (err) (count_over_time({app="api"} | json | level="error" [5m]))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Maydon nomlari har servisda boshqacha (`userId`, `user_id`, `uid`) — umumiy sxema (OpenTelemetry semantic conventions yoki ichki standart) kerak.
- Ko'p qatorli stack trace — bitta JSON maydonga yozing, aks holda log yig'uvchi bo'laklarga ajratadi.
- Yuqori kardinallikli qiymatlarni (user_id) Loki **label**'iga aylantirish — indeks portlaydi; ular log tanasida qolsin.
- Shaxsiy ma'lumotni maydon sifatida yozish — endi uni qidirish ham oson (xavf ham).

**Senior nuqta:** Strukturaviy log + `trace_id` — log, metrika va trace'ni bog'lovchi ip. Bitta trace_id bo'yicha butun so'rov yo'lini barcha servislarda topish incident vaqtini keskin qisqartiradi.

33316.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Container ilovasi log'ni **stdout/stderr**ga yozadi. Container runtime ularni node'da `/var/log/pods/<ns>_<pod>_<uid>/<container>/*.log` fayllariga saqlaydi, kubelet rotation qiladi. `kubectl logs` shu fayllarni kubelet orqali o'qiydi. Markaziy saqlash uchun DaemonSet agent (Fluent Bit, Grafana Alloy, Vector) fayllarni o'qib Loki/Elasticsearch'ga yuboradi.

**Muammo:** pod o'chirildi yoki node almashtirildi — log'lar ham ketdi. `kubectl logs` faqat hozirgi va oldingi container'ni ko'rsatadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app -> stdout/stderr
   -> containerd -> /var/log/pods/prod_api-x_<uid>/api/0.log (rotation: 10Mi x 5)
        |                         |
   kubectl logs (kubelet API)    Fluent Bit DaemonSet (tail) -> Loki / Elastic
                                   + K8s metadata (namespace, pod, label)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl logs api-x                       # hozirgi container
kubectl logs api-x -c sidecar            # ko'p container'li pod
kubectl logs api-x --previous            # restartdan oldingi
kubectl logs -f deploy/api --since=10m --timestamps
kubectl logs -l app=api --max-log-requests=10 --prefix
stern api -n prod                        # ko'p pod log'i bir oqimda
# node'da:
ls /var/log/pods/
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova log'ni container ichidagi faylga yozadi — `kubectl logs` bo'sh, agent ham ko'rmaydi, disk to'ladi. 12-factor: stdout.
- `--previous` faqat bitta oldingi container'ni ko'rsatadi.
- Rotation tufayli shovqinli servisda soatlik log ham node'da qolmasligi mumkin.
- Docker'dagi `docker logs` K8s node'larida (containerd) ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Node — log uchun vaqtinchalik bufer, xolos. Markaziy log tizimi, saqlash muddati va kirish huquqi siyosati bo'lmasa incident tahlili va audit imkonsiz.

33317.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ELK (Elasticsearch)** — log'ning **to'liq matnini indekslaydi**: har so'z bo'yicha tez qidiruv, murakkab agregatsiya, lekin xotira/disk/CPU qimmat. **Loki** — faqat **label**'larni (namespace, app, level) indekslaydi, log tanasini siqib object storage'ga (S3) saqlaydi va qidiruvda "grep"ga o'xshab skanerlaydi: arzon, oddiy, Grafana bilan integratsiya, lekin label'siz keng qidiruv sekinroq.

**Muammo:** kuniga 2 TB log — Elasticsearch'da indeks hajmi va klaster narxi byudjetdan oshdi; yoki Loki'da "butun cluster bo'yicha shu xato matnini top" so'rovi daqiqalab ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Elasticsearch:  log -> tokenlar -> inverted index (har so'z -> hujjatlar)
                qidiruv: indeksdan darhol; saqlash: indeks + manba (~1-1.5x)
Loki:           log -> stream (label to'plami) -> siqilgan chunk -> S3
                indeks: faqat label'lar
                qidiruv: label bilan oqimni tanlash -> chunk'larni parallel skan
```

**Amalda:**
```logql
{namespace="prod", app="api"} |= "timeout" | json | latency_ms > 500
sum by (app) (rate({namespace="prod"} |= "error" [5m]))
```
```
# Kibana KQL
kubernetes.namespace:"prod" and message:"timeout" and latency_ms > 500
```

| | ELK | Loki |
|---|---|---|
| Indeks | to'liq matn | faqat label |
| Narx | yuqori | past (S3) |
| Erkin qidiruv | tez | sekinroq |
| Operatsiya | murakkab (shard, heap) | oddiyroq |
| Yaxshi joyi | xavfsizlik tahlili, qidiruv | ops log, Grafana |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Loki'da yuqori kardinallikli label (user_id, request_id) — millionlab stream, ishlash yiqiladi.
- Elasticsearch'da mapping portlashi (har xil maydon nomlari) va heap muammolari.
- Ikkalasida ham saqlash muddati siyosatisiz xarajat cheksiz o'sadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov so'rov uslubiga bog'liq: "aniq servis, aniq vaqt oralig'i" (ops) — Loki; "butun ma'lumot bo'ylab erkin qidiruv va tahlil" (SIEM, biznes) — Elastic/OpenSearch. Ko'p kompaniyalar ikkalasini turli maqsadda ishlatadi.

33318.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **SLI** (indicator) — o'lchanadigan ko'rsatkich: "muvaffaqiyatli so'rovlar ulushi", "p99 latency < 300ms bo'lgan so'rovlar ulushi". **SLO** (objective) — ichki maqsad: "30 kunda SLI >= 99.9%". **SLA** (agreement) — mijoz bilan yuridik/moliyaviy shartnoma: "99.5% dan past bo'lsa pul qaytaramiz". SLA odatda SLO'dan yumshoqroq bo'ladi.

**Muammo:** "tizim tez va ishonchli bo'lsin" — o'lchab bo'lmaydi. Bitta jamoa "100% uptime" talab qiladi, boshqasi deploy qila olmaydi. SLO ishonchlilikni raqamli va kelishilgan qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SLI:  yaxshi so'rovlar / jami so'rovlar   (o'lchov)
SLO:  SLI >= 99.9% / 30 kun               (ichki maqsad)
      error budget = 0.1% = ~43 daqiqa/oy
SLA:  >= 99.5%, aks holda 10% kredit       (tashqi va'da)
99.9 (SLO) > 99.5 (SLA) -> SLA buzilishidan oldin ogohlanish zaxirasi
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# SLI: 5xx bo'lmagan so'rovlar ulushi (30 kun)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code!~"5.."}[30d]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[30d]))
```
| SLO | Oyiga ruxsat etilgan downtime |
|---|---|
| 99% | ~7.2 soat |
| 99.9% | ~43 daqiqa |
| 99.99% | ~4.3 daqiqa |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SLI'ni server CPU yoki "pod Running" bo'yicha tanlash — foydalanuvchi tajribasini aks ettirmaydi. Foydalanuvchiga yaqin joyda (LB, klient) o'lchang.
- 100% SLO — imkonsiz va o'zgarishlarni to'xtatadi.
- Juda ko'p SLO — hech biri jiddiy qabul qilinmaydi. Har servis uchun 2-4 ta.

**Senior nuqta:** SLO — texnik emas, biznes qarori: har qo'shimcha "9" narxi taxminan 10 barobar oshadi. SLO'ni mahsulot egasi bilan kelishing va error budget siyosatiga bog'lang (budget tugasa — feature emas, ishonchlilik ishi).

33319.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Google SRE'ning to'rt oltin signali: **Latency** (so'rov qancha vaqt oladi; muvaffaqiyatli va xatoli alohida), **Traffic** (yuk: RPS, xabar/sek), **Errors** (muvaffaqiyatsiz so'rovlar ulushi, shu jumladan "200 lekin noto'g'ri"), **Saturation** (resurs qanchalik to'lgan: CPU, memory, navbat, ulanish pool). Har foydalanuvchiga ko'rinadigan servis uchun shu to'rttasi bo'lsa, muammolarning ko'pi ko'rinadi.

**Muammo:** 200 ta grafik bor dashboard — incident paytida qayerga qarashni hech kim bilmaydi. Oltin signallar "birinchi qaraladigan" minimal to'plam.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
             +-----------+
 Traffic --> |  servis   | --> Latency (p50/p95/p99)
             |           | --> Errors (5xx %, timeout)
             +-----------+
                 Saturation (CPU, mem, pool, queue)
Bog'liq metodlar: RED (Rate, Errors, Duration) — servislar uchun;
                 USE (Utilization, Saturation, Errors) — resurslar uchun.
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m]))                                    # traffic
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m]))   # errors
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}[5m])))  # latency
max(db_pool_in_use / db_pool_max)                                                # saturation
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- O'rtacha latency — yaxshi ko'rinadi, lekin 1% foydalanuvchi 5 soniya kutadi. Percentile ishlating.
- Xatolar tez qaytgani uchun latency yaxshilanib ko'rinadi — xato va muvaffaqiyatli so'rovlar latency'sini ajrating.
- Saturation'ni faqat CPU deb bilish — ko'pincha cheklovchi resurs DB pool, thread pool yoki navbat.

**Senior nuqta:** Har yangi servis "golden signals dashboard" bilan birga chiqsin (shablon). Alert'lar esa simptomga (errors, latency — SLO) qo'yilsin, sabablarga (CPU 80%) emas.

33320.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Blackbox monitoring** — tizimni tashqaridan, foydalanuvchi kabi tekshirish: HTTP so'rov, DNS, TCP, TLS sertifikat muddati (Prometheus blackbox_exporter, synthetic monitoring, uptime servislar). **Health check endpoint** — ilovaning o'z holatini bildiradigan URL (`/healthz`, `/ready`), LB, K8s probe va monitoring uchun.

**Muammo:** barcha ichki metrikalar yashil, lekin foydalanuvchilar saytga kira olmaydi — DNS buzilgan yoki sertifikat tugagan. Ichkaridan (whitebox) qarash buni ko'rmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Whitebox: ilova ichidan metrika (RPS, error, latency)  -> "nima uchun"
Blackbox: tashqi prober -> DNS -> TLS -> LB -> ilova  -> "ishlayaptimi?"
                 (bir necha region'dan)
Health endpoint:
  /healthz (liveness)  -> jarayon tirikmi, tashqi bog'liqlik tekshirilmaydi
  /ready   (readiness) -> trafik olishga tayyormi (warmup, kritik bog'liqlik)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# blackbox_exporter module
modules:
  http_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http: { valid_status_codes: [200], fail_if_body_not_matches_regexp: ["ok"] }
```
```promql
probe_success{instance="https://shop.example.com"} == 0
(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400 < 14
```
```bash
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n' https://shop.example.com/healthz
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Health endpoint har chaqiruvda DB'ga og'ir so'rov — o'zi yuk yaratadi.
- Health endpoint ichki ma'lumotni (versiya, ulanish satri, xato tafsiloti) ochiq ko'rsatadi — tashqaridan faqat minimal javob, batafsil holat ichki tarmoqqa.
- Faqat bitta joydan probe — prober'ning o'z tarmoq muammosi yolg'on alert beradi; 2-3 joydan tekshirib, ko'pchilik fail bo'lsa alert.

**Senior nuqta:** Blackbox — SLO'ning foydalanuvchi nuqtai nazaridan eng yaqin o'lchovi va "hamma narsa yashil, lekin ishlamayapti" holatining yagona himoyasi. Kritik foydalanuvchi yo'llari (login, checkout) uchun ko'p qadamli synthetic test qo'shing.

33321.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Distributed tracing — bitta so'rovning ko'p servislar bo'ylab yo'lini kuzatish. **Trace** — butun so'rov yo'li; **span** — bitta operatsiya (HTTP chaqiruv, DB query) boshlanish/tugash vaqti va atributlari bilan; **trace_id** — barcha span'larni bog'laydigan yagona identifikator, servislar orasida header (`traceparent`, W3C Trace Context) orqali uzatiladi.

**Muammo:** checkout 3 soniya — lekin 8 ta servis ishtirok etadi. Qaysi biri sekin? Log'lar alohida, metrikalar o'rtacha — faqat trace "qayerda vaqt ketdi"ni ko'rsatadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
trace_id=4bf9...
[gateway  0ms ---------------------------------------- 3000ms]
  [checkout 10ms ------------------------------------- 2990ms]
     [cart   20ms -- 120ms]
     [payment 130ms ---------------------------- 2900ms]
         [db query 140ms -------------------- 2850ms]   <- aybdor
Har span: span_id, parent_span_id, nom, atributlar, status
```

**Amalda (OpenTelemetry):**
```go
tracer := otel.Tracer("checkout")
ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "charge-card")
defer span.End()
span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("order.id", id))
// HTTP klient otelhttp bilan o'ralsa traceparent header avtomatik qo'shiladi
```
```bash
# header ko'rinishi
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
```
Backend'lar: Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, Zipkin, bulut (X-Ray, Cloud Trace); yig'ish — OpenTelemetry Collector.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta servis header'ni uzatmasa trace ikkiga bo'linadi — kutubxona/proxy darajasida avtomatik instrumentatsiya.
- 100% trace yozish qimmat — sampling (head 1-10% yoki tail-based: faqat xato va sekinlar).
- Span atributlariga shaxsiy ma'lumot (karta raqami, email) yozish — trace backend ham PII ombori bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Trace'ning qiymati log va metrika bilan bog'langanda: log'da `trace_id`, metrika grafigidan exemplar orqali aniq trace'ga o'tish. Tail-based sampling bilan "qiziq" so'rovlarni saqlab, xarajatni nazorat qiling.

33323.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Burn rate — error budget qanchalik tez yonayotgani: `burn rate = hozirgi xato ulushi / ruxsat etilgan xato ulushi`. Burn rate 1 = budget aynan 30 kunda tugaydi; 14.4 = 2 kunda (1 soatda budgetning 2%i). Multi-window burn rate alert (masalan 1h va 5m oynada 14.4 dan katta) — foydalanuvchiga ta'sir qiladigan va SLO'ni xavf ostiga qo'yadigan muammoga tez, kichik qisqa sakrashlarga esa alert bermaydi.

**Muammo:** "error rate > 1% bo'lsa alert" — tunda 2 daqiqalik sakrash on-call'ni uyg'otadi (shovqin), sekin 0.5% xato esa butun oy budgetini yeydi va alert yo'q (ko'rinmas).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SLO 99.9% -> ruxsat etilgan xato 0.1%
hozir xato 1.44%  -> burn rate 14.4 -> budget 30/14.4 = ~2 kunda tugaydi
Google SRE tavsiyasi:
  page:   burn 14.4 (1h & 5m)  -> budget 2% / 1 soat
  page:   burn 6    (6h & 30m) -> 5% / 6 soat
  ticket: burn 1    (3d & 6h)  -> 10% / 3 kun
Uzun oyna = ahamiyat, qisqa oyna = hozir ham davom etyapti (tez tiklanish)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- alert: ApiErrorBudgetFastBurn
  expr: |
    (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code=~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[1h]))) > (14.4 * 0.001)
    and
    (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m]))) > (14.4 * 0.001)
  labels: { severity: page }
  annotations: { summary: "API error budget 1 soatda 2% yondi" }
```
Generatorlar: Sloth, Pyrra, OpenSLO — SLO ta'rifidan qoidalarni avtomatik yaratadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kam trafikli servisda 1 ta xato = katta foiz — minimal so'rov soni sharti qo'shing.
- Recording rule'larsiz 30 kunlik so'rovlar Prometheus'ni og'irlashtiradi.
- SLO noto'g'ri tanlangan bo'lsa burn rate alert ham noto'g'ri — avval SLI'ni to'g'rilang.

**Senior nuqta:** Burn rate alert'lar "sabab" emas, "foydalanuvchi og'rig'i" bo'yicha uyg'otadi — alert soni kamayadi, har biri esa haqiqiy. Sabab-alert'larni (CPU, disk) ticket darajasiga tushiring.

33324.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Variable qiymati bir nechta manbadan keladi: `default`, `TF_VAR_<nom>` env, `terraform.tfvars`, `*.auto.tfvars`, `-var-file` va `-var`. Keyingisi oldingisini bosadi: buyruq qatoridagi `-var` eng kuchli.

**Precedence (pastdan yuqoriga — yuqori g'olib):**
```
default (variable blokida)
TF_VAR_name (environment)
terraform.tfvars
terraform.tfvars.json
*.auto.tfvars (alifbo tartibida)
-var / -var-file (buyruq qatorida, tartib bo'yicha)   <- eng ustun
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
variable "instance_type" {
  type        = string
  default     = "t3.micro"
  description = "EC2 o'lchami"
  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^t3\\.", var.instance_type))
    error_message = "Faqat t3 oilasi."
  }
}
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true      # default yo'q -> majburiy
}
```
```bash
terraform plan -var-file=envs/prod.tfvars
terraform plan -var 'instance_type=t3.large'
export TF_VAR_db_password="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
  --secret-id prod/db --query SecretString --output text)"
```
```hcl
# envs/prod.tfvars
instance_type = "t3.large"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'ni `.tfvars` ga yozib commit qilish — `*.tfvars` ni ignore qiling yoki env/secret manager ishlating.
- `default` siz variable'ga qiymat berilmasa, CI'da interaktiv so'rov — pipeline osilib qoladi (`-input=false` qo'ying).
- `TF_VAR_` ning `-var-file` ni bosishini kutish — aksincha.

**Senior nuqta:** Muhitga xos qiymatlar `envs/<env>.tfvars` da (review qilinadi), secret'lar esa umuman variable orqali emas — data source yoki managed password orqali.

33325.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `terraform fmt` — kodni kanonik formatga keltiradi (diff toza); `validate` — sintaksis va ichki mantiqni tekshiradi (cloud'ga ulanmasdan); `.terraform.lock.hcl` — provider'larning aniq versiyasi va checksum'larini qotiradi, shunda hamma bir xil provider bilan ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Constraint `~> 5.0`. Bugun sizda 5.60, ertaga CI'da 5.80 yuklandi va plan boshqacha. Lock fayl bunga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
required_providers (diapazon: ~> 5.60)
          |
   terraform init --> lock fayl (aniq: 5.62.0 + hash'lar)
          |
   keyingi init'lar --> lock'dagi versiya (init -upgrade bo'lmaguncha)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
terraform fmt -recursive            # formatlash
terraform fmt -recursive -check     # CI: formatlanmagan bo'lsa exit 3
terraform validate                  # Success! The configuration is valid.
terraform init -upgrade             # constraint ichida yangilash, lock yangilanadi
terraform providers lock \
  -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64   # hamma platforma hash'lari
```
```hcl
required_providers {
  aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws", version = "~> 5.60" }   # >=5.60, <6.0
}
```
`.gitignore`: `.terraform/` — commit qilinmaydi; `.terraform.lock.hcl` — **commit qilinadi**.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lock faylni ignore qilish — reproducibility yo'qoladi.
- Mac'da yaratilgan lock'da faqat `darwin_arm64` hash — Linux CI'da xato; `providers lock -platform` bilan hamma platformani qo'shing.
- `validate` variable qiymatlari va cloud holatini tekshirmaydi — `plan` o'rnini bosmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Provider yangilanishini Renovate/Dependabot orqali alohida PR'da, plan bilan qiling — boshqa o'zgarishlar bilan aralashtirmang.

33326.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `locals` — konfiguratsiya ichida qayta ishlatiladigan hisoblangan qiymatlar (nom prefiksi, umumiy tag'lar); `output` — natijani foydalanuvchiga yoki boshqa modul/state'ga chiqarish; `depends_on` — atribut murojaati bo'lmagan yashirin bog'liqlikni majburlash (kamdan-kam).

**Amalda:**
```hcl
locals {
  name = "${var.project}-${var.env}"
  tags = { project = var.project, env = var.env, managed_by = "terraform" }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
  default_tags { tags = local.tags }    # hamma resursga avtomatik
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "logs" {
  bucket = "${local.name}-logs"
}

output "bucket_name" { value = aws_s3_bucket.logs.bucket }
output "db_password" {

  sensitive = true

```
`depends_on` misoli — Lambda IAM policy biriktirilmaguncha ishga tushmasligi kerak, lekin unga atribut orqali murojaat yo'q:
```hcl
resource "aws_lambda_function" "fn" {
  # ...
  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.logs]
}
```
```bash
terraform output bucket_name
terraform output -json | jq -r .bucket_name.value
```

| Vosita | Qachon |
|---|---|
| `variable` | tashqaridan kiruvchi qiymat |
| `locals` | ichki hisob, takrorni yo'qotish |
| `output` | modul "API"si |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `depends_on` ni ko'p ishlatish — graph noaniq, parallelizm kamayadi, ba'zan data source'lar plan'da "known after apply" bo'lib qoladi.
- `sensitive` output ham state'da ochiq turadi.
- `locals` ichida murakkab mantiq — o'qib bo'lmaydigan kod.

**Senior nuqta:** Output'lar — modulning ommaviy kontrakti: ularni o'zgartirish breaking change. Faqat iste'molchilarga kerakli narsani chiqaring.

33327.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `-/+` — resurs o'chirilib, qayta yaratiladi (replace). DB, disk yoki bucket uchun bu ma'lumot yo'qolishi yoki downtime demak. Qaysi atribut "forces replacement" ekanini topib, sababini bartaraf qilasiz yoki xavfsiz rejalashtirasiz.

**O'qish:**
```
  # aws_db_instance.main must be replaced
-/+ resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
      ~ identifier = "prod-db" -> "prod-main-db" # forces replacement
        ...
    }
Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy.
```

**Tekshiruv tartibi:**
```
1. qaysi maydon "# forces replacement"?
2. ataylabmi? 
   yo'q -> kodni qaytaring / ignore_changes
   rename (resurs manzili) -> moved {} blok
   ha, majburiy -> 3
3. DB/disk: snapshot, prevent_destroy, maintenance oyna, create_before_destroy
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
terraform plan -out tf.plan
terraform show -json tf.plan | jq -r '.resource_changes[]
  | select(.change.actions | index("delete")) | .address'
# CI'da: delete bo'lsa qo'shimcha approval
```
```hcl
moved {
  from = aws_db_instance.db
  to   = aws_db_instance.main
}
resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }
  deletion_protection = true
}
```
Ataylab qayta yaratish: `terraform apply -replace=aws_instance.web`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Immutable atributlar (nom, AZ, engine, subnet group) — o'zgarishi har doim replace.
- Data source (`most_recent` AMI) o'zgarishi yashirin replace chaqiradi.
- Provider yangilanishidan keyingi kutilmagan replace — changelog o'qing.

**Senior nuqta:** Plan'dagi har `destroy`/`replace` ni CI'da avtomatik aniqlab, alohida tasdiq talab qiling — inson ko'zi uzun plan'da uni o'tkazib yuborishi oson.

33329.a:

```yaml
# GitHub Actions (qisqartirilgan)
permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read, pull-requests: write }
jobs:

      with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/tf-plan, aws-region: eu-central-1 }
```

33330.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ad-hoc buyruq — playbook yozmasdan bitta modulni bir yoki ko'p hostda darhol bajarish (`ansible <hostlar> -m <modul> -a <argumentlar>`). Tezkor tekshiruv, ma'lumot yig'ish yoki bir martalik ish uchun; takrorlanadigan ish playbook'ga.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ansible web -m ansible.builtin.service -a "name=nginx state=restarted" --become
   |      |                   |                         |
 hostlar  modul           argumentlar                  sudo
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ansible all -i inventory.ini -m ping               # ulanish bormi
ansible web -i inventory.ini -a "uptime"           # default modul: command
ansible web -a "df -h /" -o                        # bir qatorli chiqish
ansible web -m ansible.builtin.apt -a "name=htop state=present" --become
ansible db  -m ansible.builtin.service -a "name=postgresql state=restarted" --become
ansible web -m ansible.builtin.setup -a "filter=ansible_distribution*"   # facts
ansible all -m ping --limit web1
ansible web -m shell -a "ss -tlnp | grep 443" --become -f 20     # 20 parallel
```
Chiqish: `web1 | CHANGED | rc=0 >>` yoki `web2 | UNREACHABLE!` — qaysi host muammoli darhol ko'rinadi.

**Qachon:**
| Ad-hoc | Playbook |
|---|---|
| "hamma serverda disk qancha?" | doimiy konfiguratsiya |
| incident'da servisni restart | deploy |
| facts'ni ko'rish | review va tarix kerak bo'lgan ish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ad-hoc bilan prod konfiguratsiyasini o'zgartirish — Git'da izi yo'q, keyingi playbook run uni qaytaradi.
- `-a` bilan `command` moduli pipe (`|`) va `>` ni tushunmaydi — `-m shell` kerak.
- `all` ga xavfli buyruq — avval `--limit` va `--check`.

**Senior nuqta:** Incident paytida ad-hoc qilingan har o'zgarishni keyin playbook'ga ko'chiring, aks holda u keyingi deploy'da jimgina bekor bo'ladi.

33331.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ansible SSH bilan ulanadi: `ansible_user` (qaysi user), `ansible_ssh_private_key_file` (qaysi kalit), `ansible_host` (IP). Root huquqi kerak bo'lsa `become: true` — sudo orqali ko'tariladi. Host key'lar `known_hosts` da oldindan bo'lishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
control node --SSH (deploy@10.0.1.10, ed25519 key)--> web1
                                     |
                         python modul yuboriladi
                         become: sudo -u root modulni ishga tushiradi
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# inventory.ini
[web]
web1 ansible_host=10.0.1.10
[web:vars]
ansible_user=deploy
ansible_ssh_private_key_file=~/.ssh/deploy_ed25519
```
```yaml
- hosts: web
  become: true           # sudo
  become_user: root      # default
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }
    - ansible.builtin.command: whoami
      become_user: postgres          # boshqa userga
```
```bash
ansible-playbook site.yml --ask-become-pass    # sudo parol so'raladi (-K)
ssh-keyscan -H 10.0.1.10 >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts # host key'ni oldindan qo'shish
ansible web -m ping -vvv                       # ulanish debug
```
```ini
# ansible.cfg
[defaults]
remote_user = deploy
[ssh_connection]
pipelining = True
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `host_key_checking = False` — MITM himoyasini o'chiradi; faqat vaqtinchalik lab uchun.
- Hamma serverga root bilan to'g'ridan SSH — alohida `deploy` user + sudo xavfsizroq.
- `become` bilan boshqa unprivileged userga o'tishda vaqtinchalik fayl ruxsatlari xatosi — `pipelining` yoki ACL kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Statik SSH kalitlar o'rniga SSH CA sertifikatlari yoki cloud SSM/IAP kabi kalitsiz ulanish — kalit rotation va offboarding muammosini yo'qotadi.

33332.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Facts — Ansible play boshida har hostdan avtomatik yig'adigan ma'lumot (OS, versiya, IP, xotira, CPU, disklar). `when` shartlarida ulardan foydalanib, bitta playbook'ni turli OS va muhitlarga moslashtirasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
play boshlandi -> setup moduli (gather_facts) -> ansible_facts{...}
task: when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian" -> bajariladi / skip
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Debian'da paket
      ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian"

    - name: RHEL'da paket
      ansible.builtin.dnf: { name: nginx, state: present }
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"

    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ ansible_facts['hostname'] }} - {{ ansible_facts['memtotal_mb'] }} MB"

    - name: Oldingi task natijasiga qarab
      ansible.builtin.command: systemctl is-active app
      register: st
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false
    - ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: "app o'chiq" }
      when: st.rc != 0
```
```bash
ansible web1 -m setup -a "filter=ansible_distribution*"
```
Bir nechta shart: `when: [a, b]` (AND) yoki `when: a or b`.

**Tezlik:**
```yaml
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false       # facts kerak bo'lmasa
```
```ini
# ansible.cfg
gathering = smart
fact_caching = jsonfile
fact_caching_connection = /tmp/ansible_facts
fact_caching_timeout = 3600
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `when` ichida `{{ }}` yozish — kerak emas, ogohlantirish beradi.
- `gather_facts: false` dan keyin facts'ga murojaat — undefined xatosi.
- Eski `ansible_os_family` (injected) va yangi `ansible_facts['os_family']` aralashtirish — yangisini ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Yuzlab hostda facts yig'ish sezilarli vaqt oladi — fact cache yoki `gather_subset` bilan faqat keraklisini yig'ing.

33333.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Role — standart papka tuzilmali qayta ishlatiladigan birlik (`tasks`, `handlers`, `templates`, `defaults`, `vars`, `meta`). Test qatlamlari: `--syntax-check` va `ansible-lint` (statik), `--check --diff` (dry run), **Molecule** (role'ni konteyner/VM'da haqiqatan ishga tushirib, idempotentlik va natijani tekshirish).

**Tuzilma:**
```
roles/nginx/
  defaults/main.yml    # sozlanadigan default'lar
  vars/main.yml        # ichki konstantalar
  tasks/main.yml
  handlers/main.yml
  templates/nginx.conf.j2
  files/
  meta/main.yml        # dependency, platformalar
  molecule/default/    # testlar
```

**Molecule oqimi:**
```
create (docker/podman) -> converge (role'ni qo'llash) -> idempotence (yana qo'llash: changed=0?)
   -> verify (testinfra / ansible assert) -> destroy
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ansible-galaxy role init roles/nginx
ansible-playbook site.yml --syntax-check
ansible-lint                                   # FQCN, no-changed-when, yaml xatolari
ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff --limit staging
cd roles/nginx && molecule init scenario && molecule test
```
```yaml
# molecule/default/verify.yml
- hosts: all
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.uri: { url: http://localhost, status_code: 200 }
    - ansible.builtin.command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false
```
```yaml
# requirements.yml
collections:
  - { name: community.general, version: "9.5.0" }
roles:
  - { src: geerlingguy.docker, version: "7.4.1" }
```
```bash
ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konteynerda systemd yo'q — servis task'lari Molecule'da yiqiladi; systemd'li image yoki VM driver.
- Kolleksiya versiyasini pin qilmaslik — CI bir kun to'satdan buziladi.
- Faqat lint — role haqiqatan ishlashini kafolatlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Minimal CI: lint + Molecule (idempotence bilan) har PR'da, staging'ga `--check --diff`. Bu Ansible kodini "skriptlar to'plami" dan dasturiy mahsulot darajasiga ko'taradi.

33334.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Shared responsibility — xavfsizlik vazifalari AWS va mijoz o'rtasida bo'linadi: AWS **cloud'ning o'zi** uchun (hardware, data center, tarmoq, hypervisor) javob beradi, mijoz esa **cloud ichidagi** narsalar uchun (IAM, ma'lumot, konfiguratsiya, OS — servis turiga qarab). Managed servis qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, sizning qismingiz shuncha kichik, lekin IAM va ma'lumot doim sizda.

**Qanday bo'linadi:**
```
         EC2 (IaaS)      RDS (managed)     Lambda / S3
Siz:  [ma'lumot      ] [ma'lumot      ] [ma'lumot      ]
      [IAM, SG       ] [IAM, SG       ] [IAM, policy   ]
      [app, runtime  ] [backup sozlama] [kod           ]
      [OS patch      ] -----------------------------------
AWS:  [hypervisor, HW] [OS, DB patch  ] [runtime, OS   ]
      [data center, fizik xavfsizlik, global tarmoq    ]
```

| Kim | EC2 | RDS | Lambda/S3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| AWS | hardware, tarmoq, hypervisor | + OS, DB engine patch | + runtime |
| Siz | OS patch, SG, IAM, ma'lumot | SG, IAM, backup sozlamasi, ma'lumot | IAM, kod, bucket policy, ma'lumot |

**Amalda (sizning tomoningiz):**
```bash
aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket acme-data      # bucket ochiq emasmi
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=ip-permission.cidr,Values=0.0.0.0/0
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name ci                    # eski access key'lar
aws configservice describe-compliance-by-config-rule
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "AWS'da bo'lsa xavfsiz" deb o'ylash — ko'p real incident'lar (public S3, ochiq SG, oqib ketgan key) mijoz tomonida.
- EC2'da OS patch'ni unutish — bu AWS'ning ishi emas.
- RDS "managed" deb backup retention va shifrlashni tekshirmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** Managed servislarni tanlash — xavfsizlik qarori ham: har bir qatlam AWS'ga o'tganda patch, HA va hardening yuki kamayadi. Qolgan qismni (IAM, ma'lumot) policy-as-code va avtomatik tekshiruvlar bilan boshqaring.

33335.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS CLI credential'ni zanjir bo'yicha qidiradi: env o'zgaruvchilar -> `~/.aws` profillar (SSO yoki access key) -> container/instance role. Tavsiya: odamlar uchun **IAM Identity Center (SSO)** profillari — qisqa muddatli token; serverlarda — role; uzoq muddatli access key laptop'da — oxirgi variant.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
aws s3 ls
  1. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SESSION_TOKEN (env)
  2. AWS_PROFILE yoki --profile -> ~/.aws/config (sso / role_arn / credentials)
  3. ECS task role / EC2 instance profile (IMDSv2)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws configure sso                       # IAM Identity Center, brauzer orqali login
aws sso login --profile prod-readonly
export AWS_PROFILE=dev
aws sts get-caller-identity             # qaysi akkaunt / role — har doim tekshiring
aws s3 ls --profile prod-readonly
aws ec2 describe-instances \
  --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].[InstanceId,State.Name]' --output table
```
```ini
# ~/.aws/config
[profile prod-readonly]
sso_session    = acme
sso_account_id = 111111111111
sso_role_name  = ReadOnly
region         = eu-central-1

[sso-session acme]
sso_start_url = https://acme.awsapps.com/start
sso_region    = eu-central-1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Env'da eski `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` qolgan — profilni bosib ketadi, noto'g'ri akkauntda ishlaysiz.
- Prod va dev profillarini adashtirish — terminal prompt'da joriy profilni ko'rsating, prod'ga faqat read-only default.
- `~/.aws/credentials` dagi muddatsiz key — laptop yoki backup orqali oqib ketadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Xavfli buyruqdan oldin `aws sts get-caller-identity` — odat. Prod'ga yozish huquqi faqat CI role'da bo'lsa, laptop'dan xato qilish imkoni ham kamayadi.

33336.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **EBS** — bitta instance'ga ulanadigan blok disk (bitta AZ'da), OS va DB uchun. **EFS** — ko'p instance bir vaqtda ulanadigan NFS fayl tizimi (multi-AZ). **S3** — HTTP API orqali obyekt saqlash, region darajasida, eng arzon va cheksiz. Tanlov: kim, qanday protokol bilan va qancha tez kirishi kerakligiga qarab.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EBS: EC2 --(blok qurilma /dev/nvme1n1)--> volume (AZ a)
EFS: EC2 a, EC2 b, pod'lar --(NFS mount)--> /mnt/shared (multi-AZ)
S3:  har kim --(HTTPS GET/PUT)--> s3://bucket/key
```

| | EBS | EFS | S3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turi | blok | fayl (NFS) | obyekt |
| Ulanish | 1 instance (odatda) | ko'p instance | HTTP API |
| Doira | bitta AZ | multi-AZ | region |
| Misol | OS disk, DB | umumiy fayllar, CMS | backup, rasm, log, static sayt |
| Narx (GB) | o'rtacha | qimmat | arzon |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-volume --availability-zone eu-central-1a --size 100 --volume-type gp3 \
  --iops 6000 --throughput 250 --encrypted
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-123 --description "pre-upgrade"
sudo mount -t efs -o tls fs-123:/ /mnt/shared
aws s3 cp report.pdf s3://acme-reports/
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- EBS AZ'ga bog'liq: instance boshqa AZ'ga ko'chsa, snapshot'dan yangi volume kerak; K8s'da pod boshqa AZ'ga ko'cha olmaydi.
- gp2 hali ham ishlatilmoqda — gp3 arzonroq va IOPS hajmdan mustaqil sozlanadi.
- EFS'da DB ishlatish — latency va locking muammolari.

**Senior nuqta:** Default: holatsiz servislar + S3 (umumiy fayllar), DB uchun managed servis (RDS). EBS va EFS kerak bo'lgan joylar kamaysa, arxitektura AZ yiqilishlariga chidamliroq bo'ladi.

33337.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Route 53 — AWS'ning DNS servisi. **Hosted zone** — bitta domen uchun yozuvlar konteyneri (public yoki VPC ichidagi private). Asosiy yozuvlar: A/AAAA (IP), CNAME (boshqa nom), MX (pochta), TXT (tasdiqlash, SPF). **Alias** — AWS'ga xos yozuv: domen apex'ini (`example.com`) ALB/CloudFront/S3'ga yo'naltiradi, bepul so'rovlar bilan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
brauzer -> resolver -> .com NS -> Route 53 NS (hosted zone example.com)
   -> example.com A (alias) -> ALB IP'lari (AWS avtomatik yangilaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
```
example.com        A (alias)  -> my-alb-123.eu-central-1.elb.amazonaws.com
www.example.com    CNAME      -> example.com
example.com        MX         10 mail.example.com
_acme.example.com  TXT        "verification=..."
```
```hcl
resource "aws_route53_record" "apex" {
  zone_id = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "A"
  alias {
    name                   = aws_lb.web.dns_name
    zone_id                = aws_lb.web.zone_id
    evaluate_target_health = true
  }
}
```
```bash
dig +short example.com
dig NS example.com            # registrar'dagi NS Route 53'nikimi
dig @8.8.8.8 www.example.com +trace
```

**Routing policy'lar:** simple, weighted (canary 10/90), latency, failover (health check bilan), geolocation.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Apex'da CNAME — DNS standarti ruxsat bermaydi; alias ishlating.
- Migratsiyadan oldin TTL'ni pasaytirmaslik — eski IP soatlab keshda qoladi. Avval 300s ga tushiring, kuting, keyin o'zgartiring.
- Registrar'dagi NS yozuvlari Route 53 zone NS'lariga mos emas — yozuvlar "ishlamaydi".

**Senior nuqta:** DNS — eng ko'p "hamma narsa ishlamay qoldi" sababidan biri. Muhim zonalarni Terraform'da saqlang, DNSSEC va health-check failover'ni ko'rib chiqing.

33338.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Auto Scaling Group (ASG) — bir xil EC2 instance'lar guruhini kerakli sonda (min/desired/max) bir nechta AZ'da ushlab turadi: yiqilganini almashtiradi, yuk bo'yicha ko'paytiradi/kamaytiradi. **Launch Template** — yangi instance qanday bo'lishini belgilaydi (AMI, type, SG, user_data, IAM role) va versiyalanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ALB -> Target Group <- ASG (min 2, desired 3, max 10, AZ a/b/c)
                          ^ Launch Template v7 (AMI, t3.small, user_data)
health check fail -> instance terminate -> yangisi LT'dan yaratiladi
CPU > 50% (target tracking) -> desired++
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "web" {
  min_size            = 2
  max_size            = 10
  desired_capacity    = 3
  vpc_zone_identifier = module.vpc.private_subnets
  target_group_arns   = [aws_lb_target_group.web.arn]
  health_check_type   = "ELB"
  health_check_grace_period = 120
  launch_template {
    id      = aws_launch_template.web.id
    version = aws_launch_template.web.latest_version
  }
  instance_refresh {
    strategy = "Rolling"
    preferences { min_healthy_percentage = 90 }
  }
}

resource "aws_autoscaling_policy" "cpu" {
  autoscaling_group_name = aws_autoscaling_group.web.name
  policy_type            = "TargetTrackingScaling"
  target_tracking_configuration {
    predefined_metric_specification { predefined_metric_type = "ASGAverageCPUUtilization" }
    target_value = 50
  }
}
```
```bash
aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name web
aws autoscaling describe-scaling-activities --auto-scaling-group-name web --max-items 5
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `health_check_type = "EC2"` — faqat VM holatini ko'radi; ilova o'lsa ham instance almashtirilmaydi. `ELB` tanlang.
- Grace period juda qisqa — ilova ishga tushguncha instance "nosog'lom" deb o'ldiriladi (sikl).
- Instance'da holat (fayl, sessiya) saqlash — scale-in paytida yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** ASG instance'lari "chorva, uy hayvoni emas": stateless, image'dan tayyor, istalgan payt o'chirilishi mumkin. Deploy = yangi LT versiya + Instance Refresh.

33339.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ECR (Elastic Container Registry) — AWS'ning xususiy Docker/OCI image registry'si, IAM bilan integratsiyalangan, image skanerlash va lifecycle policy'lari bilan. Push qilish: repo yaratish, `docker login` (vaqtinchalik token bilan), image'ni ECR manzili bilan tag qilish, `docker push`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI (OIDC -> IAM role) -> ecr get-login-password (12 soatlik token) -> docker login
docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/api:1.5.0
ECS/EKS (task/node role) -> pull
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ecr create-repository --repository-name api \
  --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true \
```

33340.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda — notekis, hodisaga asoslangan, qisqa (15 daqiqagacha) ishlar uchun mos: S3/SQS/EventBridge trigger'lari, kam trafikli API, cron, "yelim" kod. Doimiy yuqori yuk, uzoq jarayonlar, past va barqaror latency talabi, ko'p DB ulanishi yoki maxsus runtime kerak bo'lsa — ECS/EKS yaxshiroq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
event (API GW, S3, SQS) -> Lambda service -> issiq muhit bormi?
     yo'q -> cold start (init: runtime + kod)  -> handler
     ha   -> handler (tez)
har parallel so'rov = alohida muhit (concurrency)
```

| Mezon | Lambda | ECS/EKS |
|---|---|---|
| Davomiylik | <= 15 daqiqa | cheksiz |
| Yuk | notekis, kam | doimiy, yuqori |
| Cold start | bor (Go'da ~100ms, JVM'da sezilarli) | yo'q |
| Ops | minimal | ko'proq |
| Narx | so'rov x vaqt x xotira | soat |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lambda create-function --function-name thumb --runtime provided.al2023 --architectures arm64 \
  --handler bootstrap --zip-file fileb://fn.zip --role arn:aws:iam::111:role/thumb \
  --memory-size 512 --timeout 30
aws lambda put-function-concurrency --function-name thumb --reserved-concurrent-executions 50
aws lambda put-function-event-invoke-config --function-name thumb \
  --maximum-retry-attempts 1 --destination-config '{"OnFailure":{"Destination":"arn:aws:sqs:...:thumb-dlq"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har parallel invocation — alohida DB ulanishi; cho'qqida RDS ulanishlari tugaydi: RDS Proxy kerak.
- Asinxron event'lar avtomatik qayta yuboriladi — handler idempotent bo'lsin, DLQ/destination sozlang.
- Account concurrency limiti (default 1000) umumiy — bitta funksiya hammasini bo'g'ishi mumkin: reserved concurrency.
- Doimiy yuqori trafikda Lambda narxi konteynerdan bir necha baravar qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Qaror — narx va operatsion yuk egri chiziqlari kesishgan nuqtada: past/notekis trafikda Lambda arzon va oddiy, barqaror yuqori trafikda konteyner. Ikkalasini aralash ishlatish normal.
